business_summary: Fund Creation Group Company Limited engages in the asset management and investment banking businesses in Japan. The company invests in the fields of real estate and solar power businesses, as well as in the securities. It is also involved in the vehicle leasing; and real estate crowdfunding business. In addition, the company offers financial product intermediation services. Fund Creation Group Company Limited was founded in 2002 and is headquartered in Tokyo, Japan.

Phil Company, Inc. provides space solutions in Japan. It engages in the construction of Phil Park, an aerial retail store; and Premium Garage House, a rental housing with attached garage. Phil Company, Inc. was incorporated in 2005 and is based in Tokyo, Japan.

Japan Property Management Center Co.,Ltd. engages in leasing rental properties in Japan. The company is involved in renting condominiums and apartments; bulk leasing business; construction work; management/brokerage of rental properties; operation of senior housing; rent debt guarantee and rental management; insurance business; renovation; real estate sales brokerage business; delinquency guarantee business; and broadband business. The company was incorporated in 2002 and is headquartered in Tokyo, Japan.

Sansei Landic Co.,Ltd engages in the real estate business in Japan. The company is involved in the planning, purchasing, sale, and management of the limited property rights of the land. It also procures and sells real estate properties that involve rights adjustments relating to leasehold land, properties with existing residence, and other pieces of real estate. The company was formerly known as Sansei Service Co., Ltd. and changed its name to Sansei Landic Co.,Ltd in February 1997. Sansei Landic Co.,Ltd was incorporated in 1976 and is headquartered in Chiyoda, Japan.

STrust Co.,Ltd. engages in the real estate business in Japan. The company operates through Real Estate Sales Business, Real Estate Management Business, and Real Estate Rental Business segments. It primarily plans, develops, manages, and sells condominiums and detached houses. The company is also involved in the insurance agency; interior goods sales; and rental of offices and commercial facilities, etc. In addition, it is engaged in the buying, selling, and brokerage of various real estate, including Ovision Mansion, used condominiums, rental condominiums, and other real estate. In addition, it engages in property management business. The company was incorporated in 1999 and is headquartered in Shimonoseki, Japan. STrust Co.,Ltd. operates as a subsidiary of Saibu Gas Holdings Co., Ltd.

Nippon Prologis REIT, Inc. was listed on the REIT Securities Market of the Tokyo Stock Exchange on February 14, 2013. NPR has strategically focused on investment for Class-A logistics facilities from its inception backed by the Prologis Group's strong sponsor support and has aimed to maximize unit holders' value by maintaining a portfolio that generates stable income. As a result of such investment management, NPR owned 61 properties for 960,217 million yen, all of which are Class-A logistics facilities developed by the Prologis Group, as of May 31, 2025. Nippon Prologis REIT, Inc. was established on Nov 7, 2012.

Hoosiers Holdings Co., Ltd., a holding company, engages in housing-related businesses in Japan. The company is involved in sale of newly built condominium and detached house; participating in urban redevelopment projects; real estate investment and rental business; and renovation apartment sales business; private REIT and private fund management and consulting business. It also engages in apartment management; building management; insurance agency; interior sales and renovation; hotel management; and PPP and PFI business planning and management business. Hoosiers Holdings Co., Ltd. was incorporated in 2013 and is headquartered in Tokyo, Japan.

TRUST Holdings Inc. engages in the parking lot and real estate businesses in Japan. It operates through Parking lot business, Real estate business, Parking Lot Fractionalization Business, Medical service Business, and RV Business segments. The company operates parking lots; offers parking lot management outsourcing services; develops and sells condominiums; and provides real estate rental and brokerage services. It also provides real estate rental, money lending, and various consulting services to medical institutions. In addition, the company operates hot spring facilities; and provides security services. Further, the company manufactures, sells, repairs, and renovates campers; and produces and sells high concentration hydrogen water. TRUST Holdings Inc. was incorporated in 2013 and is based in Fukuoka City, Japan.

Hoshino Resorts REIT, Inc. (hereinafter, HRR) invests in hotels, ryokans (Japanese-style inns) and ancillary facilities. It serves at the core of the tourism industry and for which stable use is expected for the medium to long term. HRR was established under the Act on Investment Trusts and Investment Corporations (Act No. 198 of 1951, as amended; hereinafter, the Investment Trusts Act) with Hoshino Resort Asset Management Co., Ltd. (hereinafter, the Asset Management Company) as the organizer and investments in capital of 150 million yen (300 units) on March 6, 2013. An issuance of new investment units through public offering (19,000 units) was implemented with July 11, 2013, as the payment due date, and the investment securities were listed on the Real Estate Investment Trust Securities Market of Tokyo Stock Exchange, Inc. (hereinafter, the Tokyo Stock Exchange) (securities code: 3287) on July 12, 2013. HRR has steadily expanded its asset size since, bringing the assets held by HRR as of the end of the fiscal period under review to 69 properties (sum total of acquisition price: 226,650 million yen).

Open House Group Co., Ltd. operates in the real estate businesses. It provides real estate sales and purchase agency/brokerage services. The company also sells newly built detached houses; and develops condominiums. In addition, it engages in the real estate investment and finance businesses; and other businesses. The company was formerly known as Open House Co., Ltd. and changed its name to Open House Group Co., Ltd. in January 2022. The company was incorporated in 1996 and is headquartered in Tokyo, Japan.

Tokyu Fudosan Holdings Corporation, together with its subsidiaries, engages in the real estate business in Japan and internationally. The company operates through four segments: City Development, Strategic Investment, Human Resource Business Management and Operation, and Real Estate Distribution Business segments. It is also involved in condominium management, building and facility management, renovation construction, rental conference rooms, hotels, resort facilities, healthcare, environmental, and green management, as well as operates as a real estate agent. In addition, The company involved in the urban development activities. Tokyu Fudosan Holdings Corporation was founded in 1918 and is headquartered in Tokyo, Japan.

Iida Group Holdings Co., Ltd., together with its subsidiaries, engages in the purchase, planning, design, construction, sale of detached houses and condominiums in Japan. The company is involved in the contract construction; and maintenance and renovation services, as well as offers housing performance indication system. Iida Group Holdings Co., Ltd. was founded in 1967 and is headquartered in Musashino, Japan.

AZUMA HOUSE Co., Ltd. engages in the real estate and construction businesses in Japan. The company constructs and sells detached houses and pre-built houses, and condominiums. It is also involved in custom-built houses development, buying and selling of real estate, real estate brokerage, renovations, construction of facilities and stores, public works and insurance-related activities, rental management and brokerage, asset management proposal-based rental housing construction, and operation of hotels and restaurants. AZUMA HOUSE Co., Ltd. was incorporated in 1977 and is headquartered in Wakayama, Japan.

Toubujyuhan Co.,Ltd. engages in the real estate business in Japan. The company is involved in the real estate trading, leasing, selling, brokerage, and management businesses, as well as used homes and condominiums remodeling activities. It also sells and rents long-term care and welfare-related products; and undertakes long-term care remodeling work, as well as offers nursing care and real estate insurance services. The company was founded in 1984 and is headquartered in Shimonoseki, Japan.

MUGEN ESTATE Co.,Ltd. purchases and resells pre-owned properties in Japan. The company's property portfolio includes investment type properties, such as condominiums and office blocks and residential type properties, including detached houses for families. It engages in the development, leasing, and selling of real estate properties and interior and exterior construction business that includes renovate and refurbish stores, offices, office buildings, rental apartment complexes, and residential properties. The company was incorporated in 1990 and is headquartered in Chiyoda, Japan.

AMBITION DX HOLDINGS Co., Ltd., a real estate company, provides property management services in Japan and internationally. It also engages in the development and sale of properties; and rental brokerage and insurance business. Further, it involves in real estate investment business. AMBITION DX HOLDINGS Co., Ltd. was formerly known as Ambition Corporation and changed its name to AMBITION DX HOLDINGS Co., Ltd. in October 2021. AMBITION DX HOLDINGS Co., Ltd. was incorporated in 2007 and is based in Tokyo, Japan.

Teikoku Sen-i Co., Ltd., together with its subsidiaries, manufactures and sells disaster prevention products and equipment in Japan. It offers fire hoses and fire-fighting systems; rescue and special purpose vehicles; rescue and search equipment; and anti-CBRNE terrorism and HazMat equipment consisting of detection, decontamination, protection, monitoring, and other equipment. The company also provides firefighting and specialized protective clothing products; industrial rubber goods and tents; and linen yarns, fabrics, and other materials. It sells its products through sales agencies; and its own marketing department that directly promotes business to government organizations. The company was founded in 1907 and is headquartered in Chuo, Japan.

The Nihon Seima Co.,Ltd. manufactures and sells food products, industrial materials, and floor mats in Japan. The company provides food products, such as spaghetti, soup, curry, pasta sauce, and retort products. It offers jute and kenaf products, hemp bags, sandbags, binder string, linen thread, wire interposed yarn, carpet backing, hemp rope, rope, heat-retaining sheet for composite materials, Rivet bag, Hessian bag, Tamaito thread, and other PE/PP bags, as well as industrial materials such as plastic bags; and heavy packaging paper bag, kraft paper bags, easy-open bag, sewing bag, double-stitched bags, one-side stitched bag, bag for rice and wheat, rice inspection bag, PV bag, BAX bag, PE products, PP products, flexible container, cardboard products, civil engineering materials, stretch film, bag-making materials, and other transport materials. In addition, the company provides car mats, including tufted carpet, hook drag, rubber mats, resin mats, etc. It offers its food products under the Volcano brand. The company was formerly known as Nakagoe Boshoku Co., Ltd. and changed its name to The Nihon Seima Co.,Ltd. in May 1959. The Nihon Seima Co.,Ltd. was founded in 1918 and is headquartered in Tonami, Japan.

TalentX Inc. engages in the planning, development, management, and operation of the talent acquisition platform. The company is involved in providing recruitment marketing business. It offers the platform under the brand name My Series. TalentX Inc. was founded in 2015 and is based in Tokyo, Japan.

Nippon Coke & Engineering Company, Limited engages in the manufacture and sale of coke worldwide. The company is also involved in the sale of coal and petroleum coke; production and sale of chemical equipment and devices; and resource recycling, logistics, and real estate activities. Nippon Coke & Engineering Company, Limited was formerly known as Mitsui Mining Co., Ltd. and changed its name to Nippon Coke & Engineering Company, Limited in April 2009. The company was founded in 1889 and is headquartered in Tokyo, Japan.

Flying Garden Co., Ltd. operates a chain of family restaurants under the Flying Garden name in Japan. It primarily offers bomb burger; and hamburger with garlic , cheese, mountain wasabi, double the cheese, and tomato sauce. The company was founded in 1976 and is headquartered in Oyama, Japan.

Medix Inc. provides digital marketing services in Japan. It offers advertising and promotion services, such as search advertising, display advertising, feed ads, social media advertising, video ads, affiliate advertising, and advertising management service for agencies; creative design and production services, including creative consulting, EC site construction/ renewal, web advertising production, site construction and operation management, search engine optimization, and content marketing, as well as digital marketing services comprise web services, apps, DTP, videos, and novelties. The company also provides support to BtoC digital marketing and BtoB digital marketing support; and data-driven marketing services, such utilization of marketing data, support for utilizing BigQuery and BI tools, data analysis support, GA4 utilization support, CRM utilization support, KARTE utilization support, D2C marketing, and KPI operation support. In addition, it offers tag management tools, overseas advertising distribution and overseas marketing support, in-house support service, and online advertising management services. Medix Inc. was incorporated in 1984 and is based in Tokyo, Japan.

Cross Plus Inc. engages in the planning, manufacturing, and sale of apparel and non-apparel products in Japan. It is involved in the manufacture and wholesale of women's and men's clothing, fashion accessories, lifestyle products, and cosmetics, as well as provision of related guidance and consulting services. The company also provides child development support services, including therapeutic support for preschool children with developmental disabilities. In addition, it offers inspection, needle detection, and logistics processing services. It serves apparel companies, drugstores, home centers, convenience stores, other retailers, and general consumers through retail stores and e-commerce. The company was formerly known as Sakuraya Shoji Co., Ltd. and changed its name to Cross Plus Inc. in August 2001. Cross Plus Inc. was founded in 1951 and is headquartered in Nagoya, Japan.

Mitachi Co., Ltd. provides and sells semiconductors, electronic components, and electronics manufacturing services in Japan and internationally. The company engages in the sale of semiconductors, LCDs, as well as electronics components and motors for various electronics industries, such as amusement, industrial, consumer, and communication equipment, as well as car electronics and other industries. It also manufactures and sells electronic devices and modules; and assembly equipment for electronic devices, including SMT line and inspection systems. Mitachi Co., Ltd was founded in 1972 and is headquartered in Nagoya, Japan.

Recomm Co., Ltd., together with its subsidiaries, leases and sells information and communication equipment in Japan, China, India, and the ASEAN region. It operates through Domestic Solutions Business, Overseas Solution Business, and Business Process Re-Engineering (BPR) Business segments. The company engages in the sale of LED lighting; commercial air conditioners; SPACECOOL radioactive cooling materials; business phones; digital multifunction machines, such as copiers, printers, image scanners, and fax machines; energy-saving equipment; RoboWorker; UTM integration threatening control systems, MSG mail security, AI servers, and security endpoint products; virus sterilization equipment; robotic process automation products; other IT equipment; and telecommunications equipment. It also provides installation and maintenance services. In addition, the company offers outsourcing services for clients; business reform proposal consulting services; and contract management services. The company was formerly known as RECOMM Holdings Co., Ltd. and changed its name to Recomm Co., Ltd. in June 2013. Recomm Co., Ltd. was incorporated in 1994 and is headquartered in Shibuya, Japan.

Runsystem Co.,Ltd. engages in the store management business in Japan. The company operates Space Create Jiyu Kukan, a chain of multi-purpose cafes; sells, maintains, and manages various systems; and engages in real estate rental properties. Runsystem Co.,Ltd. was incorporated in 1991 and is headquartered in Sayama, Japan.

Towa Food Service Co., Ltd. engages in food business. The company operates a chain of coffee shops, cafes, and restaurants in Japan. The company was founded in 1974 and is headquartered in Tokyo, Japan.

MEEQ Inc. engages in the mobile IoT support business in Japan. It offers MEEQ, a mobile data communication service for IoT that allows to purchase and manage multiple lines from a console screen, as well as provides databases and data processing for creating IoT systems without coding or system development. The company's services include MEEQ Data Platform, which collects and processes data from IoT devices; MEEQ AI, a data processing SaaS that uses AI to process data collected and stored from IoT devices; MEEQ SIM, a IoT communications solutions; MEEQ Global SIM; MEEQ service integration, which links data in IoT storage with linked services; and MEEQ Business Tools that provides various business functions necessary for running an IoT business. MEEQ Inc. was formerly known as Sony Network Communications Smart Platform Inc. and changed its name to MEEQ Inc. in December 2022. The company was incorporated in 2019 and is based in Tokyo, Japan.

Asahi Co., Ltd. sells bicycles, parts, accessories, and other related products in Japan and China. It offers wholesale and retail general, sports, children's, folding, and electric assist bicycles; and ancillary services, such as maintenance, repair, and other services; and sales of its own branded products to franchised stores. It operates retail and online stores. The company sells its products under the Cycle Base Asahi brand. The company was formerly known as Asahi Gangu and changed its name to Asahi Co., Ltd. in May 1992. Asahi Co., Ltd. was founded in 1949 and is headquartered in Osaka, Japan.

COSMOS Pharmaceutical Corporation engages in the retail sale of pharmaceuticals, cosmetics, daily necessities, and food products in Japan. The company offers general medicines, energy drinks, oral and nursing care products, vitamins, health foods, diet foods, and prescriptions; and hair care and bath products. It also provides baby products, detergents, insect repellents, air fresheners, bath and toilet products, cooking supplies, gardening supplies, household and cleaning supplies, and clothing; processed foods, daily necessities, seasonings, confectionery, beverages, and alcohol; and tobacco and other products. In addition, the company engages in the maintenance and management of buildings and commercial facilities, traffic control, and security contracting activities. It sells its products through retail stores and online. COSMOS Pharmaceutical Corporation was incorporated in 1983 and is headquartered in Fukuoka City, Japan.

Visual Processing Japan Co., Ltd. engages in the development of digital asset management (DAM) solutions in Japan. The company offers DAM solution to support the business activities of companies by providing assistance on media content production, management and distribution. It provides CIERTO that integrates digital asset management and product information management to support the production of content across various platforms, such as e-commerce sites, websites, videos, social media, catalogs, and brochures; APROOOVE WM, a project management solution for content production such as catalogs, brochures, videos, and websites; and WoodWing Studio, an online editing and distribution system that enables online editing of media consisting of magazines, newspapers, and documents. The company serves distribution and retail, manufacturing, service, printing, housing and real estate, media and publishing, pharmaceutical and chemical, finance and insurance, and travelling and sightseeing industries. The company was incorporated in 1994 and is headquartered in Shibuya, Japan.

Metaplanet Inc. owns and operates a hotel and bitcoin-focused operations in Japan and internationally. It operates through Hotel Business and Bitcoin Related Business segments. The Hotel Business segment provides accommodation and related hotel services. The Bitcoin Related Business segment offers bitcoin derivatives. The company was incorporated in 1999 and is based in Minato, Japan.

Buffalo Co.,Ltd. operates as a franchisee of AUTOBACS stores in Japan. The company offers tires and wheels; child seats, carriers, chains, car interior accessories, and dress-up items; accessories and maintenance supplies; food and beverage services at stores; car electronics, including car navigation, car TV, drive recorder, DVD/CD player amplifiers, ETC in-vehicle devices, and connectors; and engine oils and batteries. It also provides pit services, including oil change, tire change, installation of various accessories, bodywork and painting, vehicle inspection and maintenance, body and headlight coating, and interior cleaning services. In addition, the company engages in the purchase and sale of new and used cars, as well as the operation of Yakiniku-like franchisee restaurant. Buffalo Co.,Ltd. was incorporated in 1983 and is headquartered in Kawaguchi, Japan.

Medical Ikkou Group Co.,Ltd. operates dispensing pharmacies in Japan. It also offers in residential nursing homes, such as paid nursing homes and group homes. In addition, the company provides sales activities specializing in the sale of generic drugs to medical institutions; and dispensing pharmacy business; pharmaceutical wholesale, real estate, and investment business. Medical Ikkou Group Co.,Ltd. was founded in 1980 and is headquartered in Tsu, Japan.

Kuriyama Holdings Corporation, together with its subsidiaries, manufactures and sells of various hoses, rubber, and plastics products in Japan, the United States, Canada, Europe, and internationally. The company operates through North American Business, Industrial Materials Business, Sports and Construction Materials Business, Europe/South America Business, and Other Business segments. It offers molded hoses and module; rubber and thermoplastic; coupling components, hose clamps, plastic connectors, and metal fittings products; and deck materials, rubber linings, and expansion joints for power production, plants, and shipbuilding. The company provides commercial facility tiles, train station platforms and concourse tiles, and outdoor tiles and blocks under the Kuriyama brand; and sports flooring materials, including all-weather rubber track, elastic sports flooring sheets, and long-pile artificial turf. In addition, it offers ocean and antibacterial mats; and oil-free antibacterial and reactive dye mops; hygiene-related products and water purifiers; and aromatics and sponges products, as well as engages in real estate management business. It sells its hoses products under the Kuri Tec, tigerflex, Accuflex, PIRANHA, HOSE TEC, and ALFAGOMMA brands for use in beverage, agriculture, mining, and infrastructure industries; and its rubber and TPU hose products under the OROFLEX, ARMTEX, ARMTEX BLINDEX, and Blue Devil brand names. The company was formerly known as Kuriyama Corporation and changed its name to Kuriyama Holdings Corporation in 2012. Kuriyama Holdings Corporation was founded in 1938 and is headquartered in Osaka, Japan.

Trailhead Global Holdings,Inc. operates restaurant business in Japan and internationally. It develops, manages, and franchises Chikuho Ramen Yamagoya and Basaraka through directly managed stores; Ikko-style ramen; Kyushu Noodle Master's Taste Yamagoya; Ramen Bar Yamagoya; and Chikuho fried chicken wings, as well as sells kitchen equipment for restaurants. The company also manufactures and sells noodles, roast pork, soy sauce, seasonings, red pickled ginger, meat, pork bone base, pure lard, takana, back fat, chopped wood ear mushrooms, and other ingredients; and engages in the real estate lease business, as well as operates hot bath facilities. The company was formerly known as Y.S.Food Co.,Ltd. and changed its name to Trailhead Global Holdings,Inc. in January 2026. The company was incorporated in 1994 and is headquartered in Tagawa, Japan.

cotta CO.,LTD manufactures and sells confectionary food materials and food packaging materials in Japan and internationally. It offers packing materials, including cake boxes, tote bags, wrapping papers, ribbons, and freshness preservatives, as well as confectionary materials, such as butter and flour. The company serves confectionary shops, bakeries, and individuals. It also sells its products through mail orders. The company was formerly known as Taisei Co.,Ltd (Fukuoka) and changed its name to cotta CO.,LTD in March 2020. cotta CO.,LTD was incorporated in 1998 and is headquartered in Tsukumi, Japan.

Mirairo Inc. provides training, research, and consulting services. The company offers training and lectures to promote universal manners; research monitors with disabilities; produces print materials and signage; and designs spaces. It also provides Mirairo Connect to remove barriers in communication for persons who have difficulty in hearing or speaking; and Mirairo ID, a digitalized disability certificate. Mirairo Inc. was founded in 2009 and is headquartered in Osaka, Japan.

Ship Healthcare Holdings, Inc. engages in the medical, healthcare, welfare, and nursing care businesses in Japan and internationally. It operates through four segments: Total Pack Produce Business, Medical Supply Business, Lifecare Business, and Dispensing Pharmacy Business. The Total Pack Produce segment sells medical devices and medical equipment based on bulk orders, as well as physicochemical; offers consulting services on medicine, healthcare, welfare, and nursing care facilities; operates veterinary hospitals; develops, sells, and maintains medical information systems; builds management business; and leases real estate to medical facilities and other tenants. It also manufactures, constructs, and maintains medical gas piping equipment, operating room interiors, shadowless lights for surgery, rehabilitation equipment, special bathtubs, etc.; and provides renovation services. The Medical Supply segment offers medical supplies and equipment to medical facilities. The Life Care segment operates nursing homes, group homes, and multi-purpose facilities, as well as power rehabilitation facilities; provides meal services; and operates and supports services for day service. The Dispensing Pharmacy segment operates dispensing pharmacies. The company was incorporated in 1992 and is headquartered in Suita, Japan.

Dynamic Map Platform Co., Ltd. develops high-precision 3D data for industries in Japan and North America. The company provides Dynamic Map Platform, an autonomous driving and advance driving assistance systems for mobility; 3Dmapspocket, a data platform that allows users to view and analyze high-precision 3D point cloud data of nationwide expressways/motorways, and arterial roads; high-precision guidance using HD map generation technology; and location information services. The company was formerly known as Dynamic Map Planning Co., Ltd and changed its name to Dynamic Map Platform Co., Ltd. in June 2017. The company was founded in 2016 and is headquartered in Tokyo, Japan.

FUJITA CORPORATION Co.,Ltd. operates and manages restaurants in Japan. The company manufactures, sells, and distributes cheese, ham, bacon, ice cream, etc. It is also involved in the food and beverage/retail, and agriculture and livestock businesses. The company was formerly known as Family Foods Co., Ltd. and changed its name to FUJITA CORPORATION Co.,Ltd. in April 1996. FUJITA CORPORATION Co.,Ltd. was founded in 1978 and is headquartered in Tomakomai, Japan.

Softcreate Holdings Corp., through its subsidiaries, provides system integration and other IT-related services in Japan. It operates through the EC Solution Business and IT Solutions Business segments. The company offers EC solutions, comprising EC site design and construction, business consulting, promotion and marketing, and infrastructure services; Sechstant, an EC and omnichannel marketing analysis platform; and Revico, a review optimization tool. It also provides IT outsourcing and cloud system integration services; L2Blocker, a security product; as well as workflow systems for small, medium, and large-scale firms. In addition, the company plans, produces, analyses, and operates content; and produces media and corporate sites. Further, it is involved in visual marketing-related businesses. Softcreate Holdings Corp. was incorporated in 1969 and is headquartered in Tokyo, Japan.

KANMONKAI Co., Ltd. engages in the development, operation, management, and franchise of restaurants in Japan and internationally. The company operates directly managed and franchised stores under the Genpin name. It also processes, manufactures, and sells seafood and marine products. In addition, the company engages in product development; research and development of patented technologies related to the procurement; and processing and transportation of ingredients, such as pufferfish, etc. KANMONKAI Co., Ltd. was formerly known as Sakanatei Co., Ltd. and changed its name to KANMONKAI Co., Ltd. in March 2001. The company was founded in 1980 and is headquartered in Matsubara, Japan.

Naigai Tec Corporation purchases, imports, exports, and sells pneumatic devices, pneumatic application devices, working machines, electric and electronic devices, and other tools. It offers pneumatic, vacuum, mechatronics, temperature control, fluid control, environmental and energy-saving, and measuring equipment; power and electronic device; and other products related to devices and logistics, as well as products for semiconductor and liquidcrystal industries. The company is involved in the assembly, repair, and maintenance of semiconductors, FPD manufacturing equipment, etc.; wholesale, import, export and other agent businesses for machines, electronic facilities, and other components; measurement and instrumentation equipment; and provision of consulting and after-sales services and related ancillary services. Naigai Tec Corporation was incorporated in 1961 and is headquartered in Tokyo, Japan.

BIKE O & COMPANY Ltd. retails used motorcycles in Japan. The company also engages in the sale of new motorcycles wholesale to motorcycle retail stores and other dealers via auctions for dealers, and public through stores and online sales via the internet; export of vehicles; and sale of used motorcycle parts and accessories; used cars; sale of e-bike through e-commerce website and physical store. In addition, the company provides vehicle liability and optional insurance; and vehicle coating services. Further, it is involved in rental motorcycle business, and sells electric mobility. The company sells its products under the BIKE O brand through retail stores and e-commerce website. BIKE O & COMPANY Ltd. was founded in 1994 and is based in Tokyo, Japan.

Seven & i Holdings Co., Ltd. operates convenience stores in Japan, North America, and internationally. It operates through Domestic Convenience Store Business, Overseas Convenience Store Business, Superstore Business, Financial-Related, and Others segments. The company is also involved in operating seven-eleven; online food shopping and internet shopping business; provision of multi-copy services, such as tickets; franchising and/or licensing activities; leasing, non-life insurance, life insurance, and credit card businesses. In addition, it engages in system development business; and printing and shiitake mushroom production. The company was incorporated in 2005 and is headquartered in Chiyoda, Japan.

Cosmo Bio Company,Limited, together with its subsidiaries, operates as a life science trading company worldwide. It is involved in the import, export, manufacture, marketing, sales, and customer support of life science research bio tools, such as reagents, kits, instruments, and software. The company also distributes antibodies, antigens, biologically active substances, enzymes, substrates, peptides, amino acids, chemicals, carbohydrates, lipids, virus components, and bacteria, as well as detection reagents, cell and tissue culture systems, and gene analysis systems; and research instruments, including electrophoresis apparatuses, cell culture labware, gene manipulation systems, and data analysis software. In addition, it provides drug discovery and custom research services; clinical diagnostics; cell and DNA, and protein engineering solutions; disposable items and general labware; and bioactive substances; consigned services, such as intestinal flora analysis, tear fluid analysis, and cell assays services; and custom peptide synthesis and antibody production services. Further, the company manufactures and sells cell/cell culture products comprising adipose tissue, bone, cartilage, tooth, pancreas, liver function, cardiovascular, immune, mesenchymal stem cells, feeder cells, tumor cell lines, macrophage-related, and coating reagents; measurement and staining kits, detection/purification kits related to neurodementia, macrophage/immune, exosome, and anti-saccharification/anti-aging; and biotechnology research equipment, such as constant-temperature transport containers, aluminum block mat heat insulation devices, and dew condensation prevention glass plate. It serves universities, public research institutes, and companies engaged in biological science. Cosmo Bio Company, Limited was founded in 1978 and is headquartered in Koto, Japan.

create restaurants holdings inc. plans, develops, and manages food courts, izakaya bars, dinner-time restaurants, and bakeries in Japan. It operates a range of restaurants, including Japanese, Western, Chinese, and ethnic cuisines primarily under the Hina-Sushi, Shabu Sai, MACCHA HOUSE, PRECIOUS BUFFET, Kagonoya, RIO GRANDE GRILL, Nanxiang Mantou Dian, Iccho, Yasai-ya Mei, Yuzuru, and Hainanese Chicken Rice Restaurant brands. The company also operates Omotenashi Toriyoshi, a restaurant that offers chicken dishes; Isomaru-suisan, a seafood and rice restaurant; and Go no Go, a casual pub. In addition, it provides bakery products under the Saint-Germain and L'airbon brands; operates JEAN FRANÇOI, a bakery and café; and operates Bread & Coffee IKEDAYAMA, a bakery that serves house made bread and house roasted coffee, etc., as well as operates Italian restaurants and highway rest areas. Further, the company operates restaurants and other facilities on a contract basis, including cultural and recreational facilities, such as golf courses, baseball stadium, aquarium, and art museums. create restaurants holdings inc. was incorporated in 1997 and is headquartered in Shinagawa, Japan.

Meiji Electric Industries Co.,Ltd. imports, exports, and sells electrical devices, measuring instruments, electrical equipment, and automation and energy-saving function components and equipment. It also designs, develops, and manufactures electronic products, inspection, mechatronic, FA, and information and distribution systems. In addition, the company offers measurement, control, and information processing consulting services; and maintenance services for industrial instrumentation and electrical measurement devices. The company was incorporated in 1920 and is headquartered in Nagoya, Japan.

ZenmuTech, Inc. provides information security solutions in Japan. The company offers ZENMU Virtual Drive, a software that harnesses secret-sharing technology to enable secure and effortless PC usage; ZENMU Engine (SDK) for data protection and authentication purposes; and QueryAhead, a secure computation database platform that brings security and change to society. The company was incorporated in 2014 and is headquartered in Tokyo, Japan.

Tsuruha Holdings Inc., together with its subsidiaries, operates drugstores in Japan. The company sells pharmaceutical, cosmetic, miscellaneous goods and food products. It is also involved in group support business; provision of Tsuruha drug care services, wellness care center, and lady care shop active; and overseas business. The company was founded in 1929 and is headquartered in Sapporo, Japan.

Delica Foods Holdings Co., Ltd. engages in the fruit and vegetable processing and distribution business in Japan. It offers fruits; whole, precut, vacuum-sealed, pre-cooked vegetables; and precut fruits, kits, dressings and sauces, and boxed fruits and vegetables. The company was formerly known as Delica Foods Co.,Ltd. and changed its name to Delica Foods holdings Co.,Ltd. in October 2017. Delica Foods Holdings Co., Ltd. was founded in 1979 and is headquartered in Adachi, Japan.

Startia Holdings,Inc. engages in the IT business in Japan and internationally. It operates through three segments: IT Infrastructure-Related Business, DX Solution-Related Business, and CVC-Related Business. The company offers digital marketing SaaS products and services comprising marketing automation tools, application creation software, web production and content management system, other digital marketing tools, AR creation software, and document management and e-book creation software that focuses on small and medium-sized enterprise markets. It also provides IT infrastructure products and services, including total support service, copier / multifunction machines, business phone, network construction/maintenance, electricity, optical line / provider, website production / promotion, cloud construction/maintenance, office design, flat-rate printer, office relocation, security camera, commercial air conditioner, LED, air cleaner, and electronic breaker to medium-sized companies. In addition, the company offers indirect operations, such as accounting management, and support operations comprising formulation of investment plans for funds and human resources, as well as engaging in discovering, executing, and counting management, and investment projects primarily in Southeast Asia. Startia Holdings,Inc. was formerly known as Startia, Inc. and changed its name to Startia Holdings,Inc. in April 2018. Startia Holdings,Inc. was incorporated in 1996 and is based in Tokyo, Japan.

Saint Marc Holdings Co., Ltd., through its subsidiaries, engages in the restaurant and cafe business in Japan. It also operates franchise chain systems. The company was founded in 1989 and is headquartered in Okayama, Japan.

Felissimo Corporation engages in mail order business in Japan. It sells clothing and accessories, clothing, personal items, daily necessities, housing, catalogs and internet catalogs for products, daily necessities, beauty and health products, handicrafts and leisure products, and food products; and provides product sales, checking delivery status, and history services. The company also operates a platform that enables business partners to list and advertise their products, as well as services to support e-commerce and logistics. Felissimo Corporation was founded in 1965 and is headquartered in Kobe, Japan.

TORIDOLL Holdings Corporation, through its subsidiaries, operates and manages restaurants in Japan and internationally. It operates through Marugame Seimen, Domestic Others, and Overseas Business segments. The company operates restaurants under the Marugame Seimen, BANPAIYA, Niku no Yamagyu, TORIDOLL, Butaya Ton-Ichi, Tempura Makino, Tonya Ton, Torido Ichiru, Nagata Honjoken, Toridon, Yamagyu General, Freshly Baked Koppe Pan, MONSTERCURRY, Kona's Coffee, ZUNDO-YA, MARUGAME UDON, WOK TO WALK, The Original Boat Noodle, SHORYU, Pokeworks, Tamjai Yunnan Mixian, TAMJAI SAMGOR, TAJMAI SAMGOR MIXIAN, and FRANCO MANCA brands. It also engages in the sale of agricultural products and household goods. The company was formerly known as Toridoll.corporation and changed its name to TORIDOLL Holdings Corporation in October 2016. TORIDOLL Holdings Corporation was founded in 1985 and is headquartered in Shibuya, Japan.
Maruchiyo Yamaokaya Corporation operates ramen restaurants in Japan. It operates restaurants under the Ramen Yamaoka-ya name. The company was founded in 1980 and is headquartered in Sapporo, Japan.

Progress Technologies Group, Inc., together with its subsidiaries, provides solutions and services for the manufacturing industry in Japan. The company offers consulting and digital engineering services. It is also involved in undertaking product development; and research and development products, such as joint research and development, and contract development and design development. In addition, the company provides support product development; and design and development, and consulting and digitalization in the design and development field. Further, it offers formulation of product development designs, system designing, tool implementation support, operational familiarization, stabilization, and execution services for implementing those designs; virtual testing environments, development and evaluation of plant models, and proposal of plans for reforming the development process; and engineering services. The company was formerly known as PTS HD Inc. and changed its name to Progress Technologies Group, Inc. in February 2023. The company was founded in 2005 and is headquartered in Koto, Japan.

Teijin Limited engages in the fibers, films and sheets, composites, healthcare, and IT businesses in Japan and internationally. The company provides aramid fibers; glass and carbon fibers, composite materials, infusion resins, adhesives, fillers and resin films, and oxidized PAN fibers; polycarbonate sheets and films; high-density polyethylene porous films and materials; and microporous films. It also offers PC resins, polyphenylene sulfide resins, molded parts, flame retardant, and additives; lightweight glass and carbon fiber reinforced composites for automotive applications; and polytrimethylene telephthalate products, artificial leather materials, polyester nanofibers, and recycled polyester fibers. In addition, the company provides pharmaceuticals for bone and joint, respiratory, cardiovascular and metabolic, and other diseases; home oxygen therapy, non-invasive positive pressure ventilation, continuous positive airway pressure, respiratory support, and sleep disordered breathing related devices, as well as sonic accelerated fracture healing system and community-based integrated care system businesses. Further, the company provides implantable medical devices and regenerative medical products. Additionally, it develops and implements engineering solutions for various issues, such as environmental pollution, energy supply stability, and aging-related workforce population decline. Teijin Limited was incorporated in 1918 and is headquartered in Tokyo, Japan.

Toray Industries, Inc., together with its subsidiaries, manufactures, processes, and sells fibers and textiles, performance chemicals, carbon fiber composite materials, water treatment and healthcare, and other products in Japan, Asia, China, America, Europe, and internationally. The company offers filament yarns, staple fibers, and spun yarns, as well as woven and knitted fabrics of nylon, polyester, acrylics, and others; non-woven fabrics; and apparel products. It also provides nylon, ABS, PBT, PPS, and other resins and molded products; polyolefin foam products; polyester, polyethylene, polypropylene, and other films; processed film products; raw materials for synthetic fibers and other plastics; fine chemicals; electronic and information materials; and graphic materials. In addition, the company offers carbon fibers, carbon fiber composite materials, and molded products; analysis, physical evaluation, etc.; and pharmaceuticals, medical devices, etc. Further, it provides engineering services; industrial equipment and machinery; water treatment membranes and related equipment; and materials for housing, building, and civil engineering applications. Additionally, it offers TORAYVINO, a household water purifier; Toraysee, a cleaning cloth made with ultra-microfiber; 3D-Gene, a high-sensitivity DNA chip; materials and solutions for automobiles; and semiconductors combined support for materials, equipment, and analysis, as well as provides services, including design, procurement, and construction of factory building, air conditioning, production equipment, and utilities right. It offers its products through & +, Ultrasuede, Ecsaine, senbism, LIVMOA, hitoe, 3DeFX+, and TORAIN brand names. The company was formerly known as Toyo Rayon Co., Ltd. and changed its name to Toray Industries, Inc. in 1970. Toray Industries, Inc. was incorporated in 1926 and is headquartered in Chuo, Japan.

Kuraray Co., Ltd., together with its subsidiaries, engages in the production and sale of resins, chemicals, fibers, and other-related materials in Japan, the United States, China, Europe, Asia, and internationally. The company operates through five segments: Vinyl Acetate, Isoprene, Functional Materials, Fibers, and Trading. It offers PVOH, PVB, and EVOH resins and films; methacrylic resins; heat-resistant polyamide resins; isoprene chemicals, thermoplastic elastomers; medical and dental products; activated carbon; membranes and systems for water treatment; lipids; PVA and polyester fibers; artificial leather; nonwoven fabrics; hook-and-loop fasteners; CMP pads; and plastic hose. The company is also involved in the manufacturing and sale of molded products; logistics; temporary staffing/recruitment; consulting; travel agency; insurance; and lodging and food service facilities. Its products are used in adhesives and sealants, agriculture and fishery, air and water treatment, architecture and construction, automotive and transportation, clothing and textiles, compounding and materials, electrical and electronics, energy and resources, food and beverage, healthcare and medical, industrial and manufacturing, life and personal care, packaging, paints and inks, and sports and outdoors applications. The company was formerly known as Kurashiki Rayon Co., Ltd. and changed its name to Kuraray Co., Ltd. in January 1970. Kuraray Co., Ltd. was incorporated in 1926 and is headquartered in Chiyoda, Japan.

Asahi Kasei Corporation engages in material, homes, and healthcare businesses in Japan, the United States, China, and internationally. The company offers Pimel, a photosensitive PI material applied for semiconductor applications, such as buffer coating, passivation layers, and dielectric layers; Sunfort, a dry film photoresist; Novacure, a latent curing agent for epoxy resin; glass fabric for printed circuit boards; plastic optical fiber; sensors and devices; artificial suede products under the Dinamica name; Microza UF and MF industrial membranes and systems; Aciplex membranes, process equipment, and systems for caustic soda production; alkaline water electrolyzer for producing hydrogen from renewable energy Aqualyzer; Hipore, a microporous polyolefin sheet which prevents the anode and cathode; Celgard, a lithium-ion battery separator; photopolymers and platemaking systems; and fiber products under the Bemberg, Bemliese, NanoAct, and ROICA names. It also provides cling film, bags, and containers under the Saran Wrap, Ziploc, and Cookper names; packaging products under the Suntec, Barrialon, PVDC latex, and Saran fiber names; pharmaceutical and food additives under the Ceolous and Celphere names; and clads and anchors under the Baclad and AR Chemical Setter names. In addition, the company offers prescription drugs in the fields of orthopedics, critical/intensive care, urology, immune system, and central nervous system; virus removal filters; wearable defibrillators, temperature management systems, pre-hospital, and hospital data management systems; overseas homes, unit homes and apartment buildings, and real estate-related operations; autoclaved aerated concretes, foundation systems, thermal insulations, and structural systems and component products; polymers, monomers, foamed products, and cleaners; and synthetic rubber, elastomers, and intermediates and inorganic chemicals. Asahi Kasei Corporation was founded in 1922 and is headquartered in Chiyoda, Japan.

zig-zag,Inc., a technology company, provides cross-border e-commerce platform services. It offers WorldShopping, a purchasing agent service for overseas customers; and WorldShoppingBIZ, a cross-border e-commerce support service for domestic e-commerce sites. zig-zag,Inc. was incorporated in 2015 and is based in Shibuya, Japan.

Balnibarbi Co.,Ltd. operates and manages restaurants in Japan. It operates through the Restaurant and Estate Build-Up Business segments. The company offers consulting services for restaurant planning and management. It also engages in the manufacture, processing, and sale of food and beverages; planning and management of weddings, parties, banquets, and other events; and manufacture of sweets. In addition, the company is involved in the promotion of regional revitalization network formation and real estate development projects; home dining business, which includes takeout, delivery, markets, etc.; e-commerce business; and restaurant studio rental businesses. Balnibarbi Co.,Ltd. was incorporated in 1991 and is headquartered in Minato, Japan.

TOYOKOH Inc. operates as a painting and waterproofing contractor in Japan. The company offers SOSEI, a spray-coating three layers of special resin to restore strong roofs; and CoolLaser, a laser-based system for removing rust and pain from aging infrastructure. It offers waterproofing, insulation and reinforcement work for roofs; and paint and rust removal services. TOYOKOH Inc. was incorporated in 1996 and is headquartered in Fuji, Japan.

KFC Ltd designs and sells construction materials in Japan. The company offers sales and installation of post-installed anchors, and manufacturing and sales of steel materials and various hardware products; sells seismic-related materials; designs and constructs buildings and other seismic-related work, and seismic structures for roads and railway bridge piers; sells civil engineering and construction materials, and electric power tools; and develops and sells inspection and diagnostic products for infrastructure facilities. It also manufactures and sells rock bolts and other tunnel support materials; lock bolt grouting materials, such as dry mortar; sells waterproof sheets and accessories for tunnels, and construction machinery such as melting machines; sells and rents rock solidification agents for tunnels such as urethane injection agents, and construction machinery such as injection machines; import sales, design, and installation of water-impervious sheets and waterproof sheets; sells guardrail repair materials; and environmental countermeasure products. Further, it designs and constructs tunnel interiors and fire-proof works, and sound insulation wall installation; designs and constructs safety facilities, such as protection fence installation work and fall prevention work; and tunnel reinforcement work and building exterior wall repair, tunnel interior lighting and disaster prevention, and facilities related to bridge sections. KFC Ltd was incorporated in 1965 and is headquartered in Kita, Japan.

Inaba Seisakusho Co., Ltd. engages in the engineering, manufacture, sale, and support of office furniture and outdoor storage sheds in Japan. The company operates in two segments, Steel Storage Units and Office Furniture. The Steel Storage Units segment sells and rents storage facilities such as storage sheds, garages, warehouses and bicycle parking areas. The office furniture segment products include desks, meeting tables, office chairs, office partitions, storage cabins, and other items. The company was founded in 1940 and is headquartered in Tokyo, Japan.

J-MAX Co.,Ltd. manufactures and sells automobile body and precision press parts in Japan and internationally. The company offers automotive parts, including auto body, front pillar inner upper and middle, roof arch, and center pillar outer products; safety augmentation parts comprising front bumper beam; battery covers and cases, binding bars, and battery frames; and functional parts, including hood hinges and tailgate hinges. It also provides precision parts consisting of tamper springs, drum sun gears, planetary carriers, drum forward clutches, pulsar plates, and rotor pulsars; dies; and inspection jigs. The company was formerly known as MARUJUN Co., Ltd. J-MAX Co.,Ltd. was founded in 1952 and is headquartered in Ogaki, Japan.

SE Corporation engages in construction material and equipment business in Japan and internationally. The company offers environmental and disaster prevention equipment, such as environmental conservation and landslide prevention, anti-seismic reinforcement of port and harbor facilities and underground structures, anti-seismic ties for bridge girders, and systems for durability monitoring; SEEE prestressing cables for prestressed concrete, outer cables, stay cables, and other products, as well as incidental engineering services for bridge and civil structures field; and public-private partnerships/concession works. It also manufactures and sells snap ties for construction of buildings and condominiums; and metal components for concrete forming and interior finishing materials. In addition, the company provides construction consulting services for community development, urban planning, R and D, disaster readiness, water, energy, environment, roads, transport, bridges, structures, repair, equipment supply, and preservation; repair and reinforcement services for roads, bridges, tunnels, dams, ports, and other facilities; construction management services for expressways; stay materials and cable erection services for the bridge; and preparatory surveys for water environment improvement projects, as well as environmental program preparatory surveys. SE Corporation was founded in 1967 and is headquartered in Shinjuku, Japan.

Atom Livin Tech Co., Ltd. plans, develops, and sells interior hardware products in Japan. It offers door locks; hinges; slide hinges; swing door fittings; sliding door locks and hardware; top-hung sliding door fittings; movable partition fittings; folding door fittings; aluminum interior fittings; handles and pulls; slide rails and wire baskets; storage and hanging hardware; clothes drying fixtures and other fittings; brass antiques; and other furniture hardware under the ATOM brand name. The company sells its products through online and hardware stores. It serves furniture manufacturers, construction hardware stores, house builders, and housing equipment manufacturers. The company was founded in 1903 and is headquartered in Taito, Japan.

Miyaji Engineering Group,Inc., through its subsidiaries, engages in the construction and civil engineering activities in Japan. It is involved in the designing, production, erection, installation, maintenance, and repair of bridges, steel frames, and other steel structures; design and production of prestressed concrete; and design, manufacture, installation, sale, and repair of bridges, coastal structures, etc. The company also designs, manufactures, and installs steel structures; sells bolts and welding materials; and offers temporary staffing services, and other business operations, as well as solar power generation activities. Miyaji Engineering Group,Inc. was founded in 1908 and is headquartered in Chuo, Japan.

TOCALO Co.,Ltd. develops surface modifying technologies in Japan, China, Taiwan, the United States, and internationally. It produces functional coatings through thermal spraying technology, including vacuum and atmospheric plasma, electric arc, high velocity oxy-fuel spraying, suspension plasma spraying, and SDC thick coatings, as well as powder, rod, and wire flame spraying processes for semiconductor and flat panel display (FPD) manufacturing equipment components, industrial machinery parts, steel rolls, paper rolls, and chemical plant parts. The company also provides other surface modification technologies, such as CDC-ZAC coating, TD process, PTA process, wet coating, WIN KOTE, plasma surface treatment technology, PVD process, and laser cladding process. Its products are used in the semiconductor and FPD, iron and steel, medical equipment, power generation, transport machinery, industrial machinery, pulp and paper, petrochemical plant, plastic and film, construction, food production, and cutting tools applications. The company was formerly known as Toyo Calorizing Industry Co., Ltd. and changed its name to TOCALO Co.,Ltd. in 1981. The company was founded in 1951 and is headquartered in Kobe, Japan.

ALPHA Corporation develops, manufactures, and sells lock and key products for automobile parts, housing hardware products, and coin operated lockers in Japan and internationally. It offers automobile parts, including power slide, velour-plated, chrome plated, and painted door handles, as well as door handles with built-in antenna, and chrome plated and painted inside door handles; intelligent keys, remote control keys, and mechanical keys for automobiles; locks for vehicles, such as electrical steering column lock, Y-shaped and intelligent key type mechanical steering column locks, and various key cylinders; and other products, including back door sensor, motorcycle bar lock, and molding bumper. The company also provides housing electric locks, such as PIN/IC card locks, push-pull battery locks, passive key locks, and WAY PLUS authentication systems; housing mechanical locks, including FB, sliding, steering wheel, stick and guard, and other auxiliary locks; delivery boxes; custom and post-dial padlocks; industrial locks for vending machines, ATMs, and game machine; and provide locker sytem. The company was formerly known as Kokusan Kinzoku Kogyo Co., Ltd. and changed its name to ALPHA Corporation in December 1990. ALPHA Corporation was founded in 1923 and is headquartered in Yokohama, Japan.

Sanko Techno Co., Ltd. engages in the fastening business in Japan. It operates through Fastening Business and Functional Materials Business segments. It offers industrial fasteners comprising post-installed, infrastructure, steel, chemical, wall, roof, construction, and other anchors; drill bits and core drill bits; setting tools; and techno testers. The company is also involved in the research, development, manufacture, sale, and installation of construction materials, composites, and engineering-related and waterproofing materials; earthquake-resistance reinforcement projects; maintenance; installation of solar panels; IT-related development; and construction guidance and management for optical related businesses. In addition, it offers zippers; electric hydraulic tools, including rebar cutters, benders, and other equipment under the DIAMOND brand; measuring instruments, including alcohol detectors; UV curable fiber-reinforced plastic sheets, printed circuit boards, and electronic devices; packaging and logistics related equipment, such as plastic vacuum forming machines and shrink pack machines for sealing objects; vehicle display panels, observation devices, computer peripherals, and communication devices; micromotor shafts and precision miniature pins; and plastic molded products. Further, the company designs and manufactures printed circuit board mounting and control devices; manufactures, imports, and sale of plastic molding machines; designs and processes precision pipe shafts and various metal parts; manufactures and sells synthetic resin three-dimensional network structures for civil engineering, such as subsurface drainage channels; develops and sells IoT devices and edge AI facial recognition products; sells systems; and leases and sells pull testers. Sanko Techno Co., Ltd. was incorporated in 1964 and is headquartered in Nagareyama, Japan.

Sumco Corporation engages in the manufacture and sale of silicon wafers for the semiconductor industry in Japan, the United States, China, Taiwan, South Korea, Europe, and internationally. It offers polished, annealed, epitaxial, junction isolated, silicon-on-insulator, and reclaimed polished wafers, as well as provides monocrystalline ingots. The company was formerly known as Sumitomo Mitsubishi Silicon Corp. and changed its name to Sumco Corporation in August 2005. The company was incorporated in 1999 and is headquartered in Minato, Japan.

Tokuden Co., Ltd. manufactures and sells welding materials in Japan. The company operates through Construction Work Business, Welding Materials Business, and Environmental Equipment Business segments. The company offers welding materials for cast iron, mild steel, high-tensile steel, and low-alloy steel; hardening, stainless steel, heat-resistant alloy, nickel and nickel alloy, copper and copper alloy, titanium, and aluminum and aluminum alloy welding materials; powder materials for plasma powder welding; brazing material for brazing; and specialized construction and other products. It also undertakes welding construction works, such as various types of welding and overhaul works to ironmaking, petrochemicals, cement, home electronics, automobile, and foodstuff industries; and provides construction using top plates, as well as environment-related equipment, including forced-cooling systems and heating equipment. In addition, the company engages in purchase, manufacture, and sale of parts for aluminum die-casting machines, such as plunger sleeves, sprue bushings, plunger tips, ladles, bore pins, etc. Tokuden Co., Ltd. was founded in 1933 and is headquartered in Kakogawa, Japan.

Mitsuchi Corporation manufactures, delivers, and sells custom fasteners for automotive components in Japan. The company offers engines, seats, powertrains, steering, rear-door locks, airbags, brakes, window regulators, undercarriage, and suspension systems; cold-forged products, including deformation, hole machining, gear processing, hole and gear processing, and forming and forging products. It also provides assembled products for window regulators and rear-door locks; and sun quick nuts, all quick nutters, and quick joints. The company was formerly known as Mitsuchi Byora Co., Ltd. and changed its name to Mitsuchi Corporation in February 1975. Mitsuchi Corporation was incorporated in 1963 and is headquartered in Kasugai, Japan.

IACE TRAVEL Corporation., together with its subsidiaries, engages in the travel business in Japan, Canada, and Mexico. The company offers business travel management (BTM) services, such as visa application assistance, expense settlement assistance, crisis management, and provision of travel data.It also operates Smart BTMJ, a cloud-based travel booking system with online reservation functionality that provides data analysis and proposals for cost reduction, multiple route suggestions, urgent booking arrangements, and a 24/7 emergency response system. In addition, the company provides personal travel services comprising domestic and international package tours, personal travel arrangements, custom travel proposals, and other benefits-related services; travel agency support services for government bodies, such as personal trips and home visits; airline ticketing, travel planning, and guided tours for U.S. military personnel based in Japan; flight bookings to Japan and international tours departing from Canada; and incentive travel and personal travel support for employees of Japanese corporations in Mexico. It serves corporate clients, individual travelers, government agencies, and the U.S. military in Japan. IACE TRAVEL Corporation. was founded in 1975 and is headquartered in Chuo, Japan.

NISSO GROUP Co.,Ltd., together with its subsidiaries, engages in the planning, design, processing, manufacturing, and sale of various metal products in Japan. It operates through Metal Processing Business, Chemical Products Business, Construction Business, Tile Business, and Other segments. The company offers solar cell array support frames, metal sandwich panels, air conditioning equipment, soundproofing and silencing equipment, and livestock waste treatment equipment; rubber and urethane products, and resin molded products, including sewer manhole earthquake-resistant joints, waterproof tapes, and resin products for vehicles; and wet and dry tiles. It is also involved in interior and exterior panel construction, solar power generation equipment construction, etc; Wood processing and sales; planning and e-commerce sales of housing equipment; manufacturing web services; and system contract development. The company's products are used in construction, energy, machinery and equipment, housing, infrastructure, transportation machinery, etc. The company was formerly known as NISSO PRONITY Co., Ltd. and changed its name to NISSO GROUP Co.,Ltd. in June 2025. NISSO GROUP Co.,Ltd. was founded in 1978 and is headquartered in Fukuoka City, Japan.

SANNO Co., Ltd., together with its subsidiaries, engages in mold manufacturing and precision press processing activities in Japan and the Philippines. The company is also involved in precious metal surface treatment processing, insert molding processing, and precision press processing of electronic components, such as connectors and switches. It primarily serves connector manufacturers. The company was founded in 1958 and is headquartered in Yokohama, Japan.

Kawada Technologies, Inc. engages in the steel, civil engineering, architecture, and IT service sectors in Japan. It operates through Steel Construction, Civil Engineering, Architecture, Solution, and Other segments. The Steel Construction segment fabricates and erects steel bridges, and building /steel structures, as well as offers steel and concrete composite decking systems. Its Civil Engineering segment constructs pre-stressed concrete bridges, prebeam bridges, half-precast structures, and precast concrete beams and pillars, as well as provides bridge repair and maintenance services. The Architecture segment offers general construction services; and provides pre-engineered metal buildings, roof-top and ground planter systems, air conditioning systems, and rainwater underground storage tank systems. Its Solution segment offers civil engineering and ICT solutions, humanoid biped robots, and industrial robot systems. The Other segment manufactures bridge expansion joint systems; provides helicopter and airplane flight services, including scheduled commuter passenger flights, sightseeing tours, chartered flights, medical and rescue flights, construction-related lifting and transporting, and other customized projects, as well as flight training services. Kawada Technologies, Inc. was founded in 1922 and is based in Tokyo, Japan.

Kikuchi Seisakusho Co., Ltd. engages in manufacturing of prototype and mass-produced products in Japan. The company is also involved in the mold making, and the manufacture of nursing care, and industrial robots; metal product processing business; tool and die manufacturing and processing; and sheet-metal fabrication and press processing. It also offers metal and plastic injection molding; magnesium thxio, insert, and cleanroom molding; and alminium hot diecast. Kikuchi Seisakusho Co., Ltd. was founded in 1970 and is headquartered in Tokyo, Japan.

RS Technologies Co., Ltd. provides silicon wafer reclamation and sale services in Japan, Taiwan, China, South Korea, the United States, Europe, and internationally. It operates through Wafer Reclamation Business, Prime Silicon Wafer Manufacturing and Sales Business, Semiconductor Related Equipment Materials, and Others segments. The company offers reclaimed wafers; prime wafers; quartz glass and monocrystalline and polycrystalline silicon components for semiconductor manufacturing equipment; electrolytes for vanadium redox flow batteries; and silicon wafer oxide film coating services. It also engages in the sale of laser diodes, ultrasonic image systems, and monitor and dummy wafers; and purchase and sale of semiconductor equipment. In addition, the company operates a solar power station with a generation capacity of approximately 1.5 MW. Further, it provides technical advising and education services on the semiconductor wafer manufacturing process. The company was incorporated in 2010 and is headquartered in Shinagawa, Japan.

JTEC Corporation designs, manufactures, and sells X-ray mirrors for synchrotron facilities in Japan. The company designs, develops, manufactures, and sells automated cell culture systems. It also offers support services related to regenerative medicine; and develops, manufactures, and sells surface treatment of various materials. In addition, the company manufactures thermal desorption analyzers. JTEC Corporation was incorporated in 1993 and is headquartered in Ibaraki, Japan.

Shinwa Co., Ltd. provides scaffolding and logistic equipment in Japan. It offers wedge-type scaffolding, scaffolding SPS, logistics equipment, pallets for scaffolding materials, and hanging pallet. The company also provides rental service. Shinwa Co., Ltd. was founded in 1977 and is headquartered in Kaizu, Japan.

Technoflex Corporation offers flexible metal hoses, expansion joints, and multi-layer pipes. The company also sells flexible and fluoroplastic hoses, formed bellows, and vacuum components. Its products are used for various applications, such as construction pipes, city water pipes, semiconductors, iron manufacturing, shipbuilding, city gas, LP gas, electricity, thermal power, nuclear power, and general plants. Technoflex Corporation was incorporated in 2001 and is headquartered in Tokyo, Japan.

B-Lot Company Limited, together with its subsidiaries, engages in the real estate and financial advisory businesses in Japan. The company offers real estate brokerage, including sales and purchase support, leasing brokerage, and consulting services; real estate development, such as market research, construction planning, management, and leasing after completion; real estate revitalization; and leasing of offices and stores, as well as property management and administrative services. It also provides real estate funds; and securitization and asset management services. B-Lot Company Limited was incorporated in 2008 and is headquartered in Minato, Japan.

First Brothers Co.,Ltd. engages in the investment management and investment banking businesses in Japan. The company offers investment management services, including fund, asset acquisition, management, and disposition services; and assess and manages real estate investment solutions, as well as hospitality services, such as operates lodging and other facilities. It also invests in funds; and invests in commercial facilities, office buildings, and assets, as well as a range of areas comprising venture capital funds, debts, private equities, and overseas real estate funds. In addition, the company provides various corporate advisory services and strategies, such as mergers and acquisitions, capital tie-ups, and financing. First Brothers Co.,Ltd. was incorporated in 2004 and is based in Tokyo, Japan.

&Do Holdings Co.,Ltd. operates in the real estate industry in Japan. The company engages in real estate management, investment, leasing, selling, brokerage, and renovation activities; commercial real estate consulting business; and franchisee and financial activities. It also plans and manages the house lease, house leaseback, and asset leaseback. The company was formerly known as HOUSE DO Co.,Ltd. and changed its name to &Do Holdings Co.,Ltd. in January 2022. &Do Holdings Co.,Ltd. was founded in 1991 and is headquartered in Tokyo, Japan.

Palma Co., Ltd. provides self-storage business solutions in Japan. The company offers outsourcing services, such as tenant applications and eligibility screenings; billing and payment, rent guarantor, and delinquency management services; on-site facility management; disposal of abandoned tenant property; information technology services, including portal site and unit inventory control system; and marketing and promotion. It also provides consulting services, such as market research and analysis, self-storage development, and representing overseas investors and operators. Palma Co., Ltd. was incorporated in 1969 and is headquartered in Chiyoda, Japan.

Ichigo Hotel REIT Investment Corporation (hereinafter referred to as Ichigo Investment Corporation). Based on the Act (Act No. 198 of 1950, including subsequent amendments, hereinafter referred to as the Investment Trust Law), Ichigo (Act No. 198 of 1951, as amended; the Investment Trust Act), with Ichigo Investment Advisors Co., Ltd. Established as a sponsor on July 22, 2015 (investment amount: 300 million yen, number of shares issued: 3,000), and issued shares on November 30 of the same year. The Company will be listed on the Tokyo Stock Exchange (hereinafter referred to as the Tokyo Stock Exchange) Real Estate Investment Trust Securities Market. Ichigo Hotel REIT Investment Corporation was incorporated in 2015 in Japan.

Ki-Star Real Estate Co.,Ltd operates as a real estate company in Japan. The company is involved in the construction and sale of detached housing, custom-built housing, and land; and real estate transactions, property management, and residential land development businesses. It also engages in real estate leasing and brokerage businesses. The company was incorporated in 1990 and is headquartered in Honjo, Japan.

Agratio urban design Inc. engages in the housing business in Japan. It operates through three segments: Housing Business, Asset Solutions Business, and Accommodation Business. The company is involved in the design, construction, and sale of new detached houses; planning, development, and sale of new condominiums; sale of entire new condominiums and apartment buildings, conversion and renovation of existing condominiums and buildings, and rental management; and support, consulting, and operation management of accommodation facilities utilizing vacant houses and vacant villas. Agratio urban design Inc. was incorporated in 2009 and is headquartered in Shinjuku, Japan.

Dualtap Co., Ltd. engages in the real estate business in Japan and internationally. The company operates through three segments: Real Estate Sales Business, Real Estate Management Business, and Overseas Real Estate Business. It plans, develops, and manages condominiums and apartments under the XEBEC brand name. The company is also involved in asset management; rental and contract management; building management; outbound support services; and non-life insurance agency business. Dualtap Co., Ltd. was incorporated in 2006 and is headquartered in Chuo, Japan.

Mitsui Fudosan Logistics Park Inc. (MFLP-REIT), a Japanese real estate investment corporation. Under the Act on Investment Trusts and Investment Corporations of Japan (Act No. 198 of 1951, including subsequent amendments; the Investment Trust Act), by Mitsui Fudosan Logistics REIT Management Co., Ltd. (the Asset Management Company) as the organizer with investments in capital of 300 million yen (600 investment units).
