The investment units were listed on the Real Estate Investment Trust Securities Market (J-REIT section) of Tokyo Stock Exchange, Inc. on August 2, 2016. MFLP-REIT started acquisition of properties on August 2, 2016. With Mitsui Fudosan Co., Ltd. (Mitsui Fudosan) as a sponsor, MFLP-REIT invests primarily in logistics facilities with a particular focus on MFLP facilities, that is, leading-edge logistics facilities with Mitsui Fudosan quality. This focus has been chosen considering MFLP-REIT's goal of establishing a portfolio that emphasizes location, quality and balance. As of January 31, 2026, MFLP-REIT held 45 properties with the total acquisition price of 546.1 billion yen. Mitsui Fudosan Logistics Park Inc. was established in March 04, 2016 and incorporated in Japan.

G-Factory Co.,Ltd. provides management support services for restaurants. It also operates and manages restaurants and offers consulting services. G-Factory Co.,Ltd. was incorporated in 2003 and is headquartered in Shinjuku, Japan.

Good Com Asset Co., Ltd., together with its subsidiaries, plans, develops, and sells condominiums under the GENOVIA brand in Japan and internationally. It operates through Wholesale, Retail Sales, Real Estate Management, Livenup Group, and Others segments. The company also provides building and rental property management services for condominiums; real estate consulting; property and casualty insurance; investment advice; investment trust asset management; financial instrument; IPO consulting for companies preparing for listing; and consulting services for listed companies regarding IR and capital policies, etc. In addition, it engages in real estate investment; real estate guarantor; development and sale of detached houses; renovation of old houses; and real estate fund business. Good Com Asset Co., Ltd. was incorporated in 2005 and is headquartered in Shinjuku, Japan.

FORLIFE Co., Ltd. provides condominiums and custom-built homes in Yokohama city, Kanagawa prefecture, Kawasaki city, and Jonan District of Tokyo. It also offers ready-built houses. FORLIFE Co., Ltd. was formerly known as Four Life & Company Co., Ltd. and changed its name to FORLIFE Co., Ltd. in May 2013. The company was incorporated in 1996 and is headquartered in Yokohama, Japan.

TKP Corporation engages in the space revitalization and distribution business in Japan and internationally. The company offers meeting rooms, banquet rooms, rental spaces, and short-term offices; selection of event or exhibit venues, arrangement of equipment, direction of acoustics and lighting, and operation on event days; and employee training, arrangement of accommodation facilities, meals, and transportation. It is also involved in the operation of hotels and training facilities; provision of catering services to business functions, meetings, working lunches, events, parties, and social gatherings; restaurant and café operation; arranging manufacture of box lunches; recruitment reception agency; call center operation; secretariat agency services; and business process outsourcing business. In addition, the company engages in lilycolor business; and novarese escrit business. TKP Corporation was founded in 2005 and is headquartered in Tokyo, Japan. TKP Corporation operates as a subsidiary of RIVER FIELD co,.ltd.

long_name: Mitsubishi Estate Logistics REIT Investment Corporation
business_summary: Mitsubishi Estate Logistics REIT Investment Corporation under the (Act on Investment Trust and Investment Corporation) (Investment Trust Law). It was listed on the REIT Securities Market of the Tokyo Stock Exchange on September 14, 2017. MEL focuses on investing in logistics facilities as a listed real estate investment corporation. Mitsubishi Estate Co., Ltd. (MEC), one of the largest comprehensive developers in Japan, has been acting as a sponsor. MEL's asset management company, Mitsubishi Jisho Investment Advisors, Inc. has an extensive track record in real estate fund management since its establishment in 2001. Through (HYBRID) (Note) utilization of the strengths of both companies, MEL aims for maximization of unitholder value by building of a high-quality portfolio and steady and stable asset management through selective investments in highly competitive logistics facilities that meet tenant needs that focus on location, building features and stability. Furthermore, MEL announced management policy (Three Pillars) on April 17, 2019, as a management plan designed to maximize unitholder value in the medium-to long-term. The management policy is intended to gather the entire MEC Group to work together and increase unitholder value of MEL, focusing on the following three pillars: Alignment (align interest with unitholders), Discipline (disciplined growth) and Hybrid (enhance MEL's unique strategy, the Hybrid model). During the fiscal period ended February 28, 2025, MEL disposed 49% of co-beneficiary interest of MJ Logipark Sendai 1 in September 2024 and acquired MJ Logipark Aisai 1 in October 2024. As a result, MEL owned 35 properties (aggregate total acquisition price: 271,593 million yen), as of the end of the reporting fiscal period (Feb. 28, 2025). Mitsubishi Estate Logistics REIT Investment Corporation was incorporated in Japan on July 14, 2016 and incorporated in Japan.

Loadstar Capital K.K., together with its subsidiaries, engages in the real estate investment business in Japan. The company invests in various real estate properties, including middle sized office buildings and hotels; sources, procures, invests, and manages assets; and operates OwnersBook, a real estate investment crowdfunding platform. It is also involved in asset management; money lending; real estate rental; hotel management contract; and financial products trading businesses, as well as development and provision of blockchain infrastructure and digital securities. The company was incorporated in 2012 and is headquartered in Chuo, Japan.

Innovation Holdings CO.,LTD. engages in the subleasing of store properties in Japan. The company operates through Store Subleasing Business and Real Estate Trading Business segments. It provides services to real estate owners and agents, and store owners and closures. The company leases and subleases commercial properties rented from real estate owners to store owners. It also engages in the real estate buying and selling; and property management business. The company was formerly known as Tenpo Innovation CO.,LTD. and changed its name to Innovation Holdings CO.,LTD. in October 2024. Innovation Holdings CO.,LTD. was founded in 2005 and is headquartered in Shinjuku, Japan. Innovation Holdings CO.,LTD. is a subsidiary of Crops Corporation.

Global Link Management Inc. operates as a real estate solution company in Japan. The company engages in investment, design, development, sales, and management of mansions. The company is also involved in management of properties and rental management business. It engages in real estate building, land planning, revitalization and development business. The company constructs hotels, office buildings, and commercial facilities. Global Link Management Inc. was incorporated in 2005 and is based in Tokyo, Japan.

CRE logistics REIT, Inc was established by CRE REIT Advisers, Inc. (the Asset Manager) as the organizer pursuant to the provisions of the Act on Investment Trusts and Investment Corporations (Act No. 198 of 1951, including subsequent amendments) and its units were listed on the Real Estate Investment Trust Securities Market of the TSE on February 7, 2018. As of the end of the current fiscal period, CRE REIT owned 20 properties, with a total acquisition price of 157,425 million yen. CRE logistics REIT, Inc was established on May 12, 2016 and incorporated in Japan.

FaithNetwork Co.,Ltd engages in the real estate investment and construction activities in Japan. It operates through Real Estate Investment Support Business and Real Estate Management segments. The company develops and sells newly built condominiums; renovation of old buildings; and manages and operates real estate activities. It also offers office architect services. FaithNetwork Co.,Ltd was incorporated in 2001 and is headquartered in Tokyo, Japan.

Azplanning Co.,Ltd. develops, leases, manages, and sells real estate properties in Japan. It operates through Real estate Sales, Real Estate Leasing, and Real Estate Management segments. The company leases commercial buildings, such as shops, offices, and warehouses; and engages in residential accommodation business. It also provides building management, tenant management, and lease agreement management, as well as house cleaning, repair work, and restoration work to rental properties and private homes; and acts as a rental broker between property owners and tenants. In addition, the company operates private lodging facilities that provide accommodation services; and sale of ancillary products. Azplanning Co.,Ltd. was incorporated in 1989 and is headquartered in Chiyoda, Japan.

GA technologies Co., Ltd. operates a real estate brokerage platform. The company offers Renosy, an AI real estate investment platform; Shenjumiaosuan, a platform that connects Japanese real estate brokerage companies with investors living in the Greater China region; dearlife, a rental estates platform for expatriates in Thailand; ITANDI BB, a site between real estate agents that allows search for properties and make reservations for previews and move-in applications; ITANDI Rental Brokerage, a sales support service for real estate rental brokerage; and ITANDI Sales PropoCloud, a sales support system for real estate sales and purchase brokerage companies. It also provides Urban luxury real estate platform; BtoB SaaS PropTech product series; and industry-specific m and a brokerage counseling. The company was incorporated in 2013 and is headquartered in Tokyo, Japan.

Mullion Co., Ltd. engages in the real estate rental and securitization business in Japan. It owns, manages, leases, and securitizes real estate properties. The company was incorporated in 1986 and is headquartered in Tokyo, Japan.

Koryojyuhan Co., Ltd. operates as a real estate company in Japan. The company offers rental brokerage, trunk room, and senior housing services. It also involved in the provision of sales intermediation; real estate purchase and sales; residential land sales; sale of real estate developed in-house; real estate fund business; and solar power generation activities. In addition, the company provides rental management, renovation proposals, vacant house management, and sublease services; and real estate consulting and coin parking services. Koryojyuhan Co., Ltd. was incorporated in 1981 and is headquartered in Mito, Japan.

Azoom Co.,Ltd provides various real estate services in Japan. The company offers CarParking, a monthly parking search site; CarParking; CarParking One, a monthly parking lot management system for managers; Tomemiru, a car parking management service for companies; Car parking cost reduction service to support refinancing for parking lot; Home deParking to monetize empty parking lot; Bikeru, a monthly parking search site for motorcycles; and car parking solutions for corporations and construction companies. It also involved in business development through internet; internet media development and operation; parking lot management and introduction; and buying, selling, brokering, managing, and leasing of real estate properties. In addition, the company provides smart space reservation to support unified management of rental space operations. Further, the company offers coin pass search, a coin parking search site; and coconi, a location-based crowdsourcing site. Azoom Co.,Ltd was incorporated in 2009 and is headquartered in Tokyo, Japan.

Kasumigaseki Capital Co.,Ltd. engages in real estate consulting businesses in Japan. The company develops and operates solar power generation business, as well as offers logistics and warehousing facilities, such as cold storage, automated, and dry warehouses. It also develops and operates apartment hotels under fav, FAV LUX, and seven x seven brand name. In addition, the company engages in the provision of healthcare facilities, as well as overseas business. Kasumigaseki Capital Co.,Ltd. was incorporated in 2011 and is based in Tokyo, Japan.

SUMINOE Co., Ltd. engages in the planning, manufacture, and sale of interior products in Japan, North and Central America, Asia, and internationally. The company operates through three segments: Interior Business; Automotive & Vehicle Interior Business; and Functional Material Business. The Interior Business segment is involved in the manufacture and sale of carpets, curtains, wallpaper, and various flooring materials, as well as interior construction and spatial design. Its Automotive & Vehicle Interior Business segment offers interior materials for automobiles, buses, and trains. The Functional Materials Business segment manufactures and sells heated carpets, related deodorizing products, aircraft interior materials, and other interior materials. The company also designs, constructs, and supervises construction of spaces. The company was formerly known as Suminoe Textile Co., Ltd. and changed its name to SUMINOE Co., Ltd. in December 2024. SUMINOE Co., Ltd. was founded in 1883 and is headquartered in Osaka, Japan.

DIGITAL GRID Corporation operates power trading platform in Japan. It operates through three Segments: the Electricity PF business; Renewable energy PF business; and the Others. The company offers Digital Grid Platform, a trading platform where users can procure electricity; Econohashi, for environmental value purchasing; RE Bridge, a virtual PPA auction site; Digital Grip Platform Battery Aggregation; and GX Navi, a practical GX human resource development service for decarbonization beginners. It also engages in the balancing power business and decarbonization education business. DIGITAL GRID Corporation was founded in 2017 and is based in Minato, Japan.

Thermae-Yu Holdings Co., Ltd. operates in hot spring facilities and the real estate and businesses in Japan. The company also sells, buys, and rents buildings and residences real estate properties; and provides hot spring bathing services, food and beverage services, saunas, accommodation services, massage and other bathing services. The company was formerly known as Econach Holdings Co.,Ltd. and changed its name to Thermae-Yu Holdings Co., Ltd. in October 2025. The company was incorporated in 1926 and is headquartered in Tokyo, Japan.

Nitto Seimo Co., Ltd. engages in the manufacture and sale of knotless nets in Japan. The company provides trap nets, purse seine nets, fish farming nets, trawl nets, and laver cultivation nets; onshore-related products, including animal damage protection and sports nets; and knotless mesh, knotless net, synthetic fiber, and knotted meshwork. Nitto Seimo Co., Ltd. was founded in 1910 and is headquartered in Tokyo, Japan.

Atsugi Co., Ltd. manufactures and sells legwear and innerwear products in Japan. It offers pantyhose, stockings, and lingerie products for women. The company also provides socks for women, children, and men; and elderly care products, such as portable deodorizing toilets. Atsugi Co., Ltd. was incorporated in 1947 and is headquartered in Ebina, Japan.

LOIVE Co.,Ltd. operates fitness studios in Japan. The company operates women yoga studio under the LOIVE brand; surf exercise studio under the Surf Fit brand; machine pilates studio under the Pilates K brand; and group machine muscle training studio under the REDY'SGYM brand name. It also provides burn-off drink under the Burn&fit brand; intestinal environment regulation tablet under the Bio&fit brand; and soy protein for adult women under the &fitPROTEIN brand. LOIVE Co.,Ltd. was formerly known as LIFE CREATE Co., Ltd. and changed its name to LOIVE Co.,Ltd. in August 2025. LOIVE Co.,Ltd. was incorporated in 2008 and is based in Sapporo, Japan.

Axas Holdings Co.,Ltd. engages in the distribution and retail of cosmetics, household goods, sports and outdoor gear products, alcoholic beverages, gardening and DIY products, and pharmaceuticals. It is also involved in the import and export of cosmetics, alcoholic beverages, household goods, and food; engages in real estate leasing business, such as office buildings, commercial complexes, and roadside stores; and engages in wholesale and retails of teak, lumber, and wooden interior products, as well as involves in insurance agency services. Axas Holdings Co.,Ltd. was incorporated in 2016 and is headquartered in Tokushima, Japan.

WILLPLUS Holdings Corporation engages in the sale and maintenance of new and used cars in Japan. The company operates through two segments, Import Car Dealership Business and Used Car Export-Related Business. It also acts as insurance agents. The company was incorporated in 2007 and is based in Tokyo, Japan.

JM Holdings Co.,Ltd. engages in the supermarket business in Japan. The company is involved in the restaurant, event-related, and outsourcing businesses, as well as wholesale and retail of meat. In addition, it engages in the facility operation and management, and rice retail businesses. JM Holdings Co.,Ltd. was formerly known as Japan Meat Co.,Ltd. The company was founded in 1945 and is headquartered in Tsuchiura, Japan.

Vega Corporation Co.,Ltd. operates EC platforms for furniture and interior products in Japan and internationally. The company operates LOWYA, which offers e-commerce services, as well as furniture designs; and DOKODEMO, a cross-border e-commerce platform. The company was incorporated in 2004 and is headquartered in Fukuoka City, Japan.

KOMEDA Holdings Co., Ltd. operates a coffee shop franchise business under the Komeda Coffee and Okagean brand names in Japan. It also involved in the real estate leasing activities. KOMEDA Holdings Co., Ltd. was founded in 1968 and is headquartered in Nagoya, Japan.

Satudora Holdings Co.,Ltd. operates drugstores and pharmacies in Japan. It also engages in the wholesale and product development; regional marketing; education; electricity; and POS system development businesses. The company was founded in 1972 and is headquartered in Sapporo, Japan.

Unisia Holdings Co. engages in the restaurant management activities in Japan. It operates through House meal business; Interior construction business; and Domestic and other segments. The company engages in operating a restaurant under the Kushikatsu Tanaka brand name; a store for chicken and eggs under the Toridama name; a restaurant specializing in grilled meat with sauce and wrapped vegetables under the Yakiniku Kuruton name; provides hospitality under Kyoto Yakiniku Kuruton and Kyoto Tempura Tenno Meshi brands; and Japanese comfort food restaurant under Tanaka brand name. It also engages in restaurant management and franchise development, business app, and system development and management; store planning, design, construction, and maintenance; web design and advertising, graphic design, and SNS management. The company was formerly known as Kushikatsu Tanaka Holdings Co. and changed its name to Unisia Holdings Co. in March 2026. Unisia Holdings Co. was founded in 1998 and is based in Shinagawa, Japan.

Baroque Japan Limited, together with its subsidiaries, engages in the retail and wholesale of apparel and accessories in Japan, China, Hong Kong, South Korea, and the United States. The company was formerly known as Baroque Holdings Co., Ltd. and changed its name to Baroque Japan Limited in February 2008. Baroque Japan Limited was founded in 2000 and is headquartered in Meguro, Japan.

long_name: Kusuri No Aoki Holdings Co., Ltd.
business_summary: Kusuri No Aoki Holdings Co., Ltd. engages in the retail of pharmaceutical, cosmetic, and daily good products in Japan. The company offers vitamin and diet supplements; and first aid and health care supplies. It also offers facial cleanser, body soap, shampoo, and toothpaste, etc. In addition, the company provides baby products, such as diapers, nursing care, sanitary products, detergent, and household products, as well as clothing products, such as socks, underwear, and home appliances. Further, it offers processed food, daily food, fresh food, seasoning, sweets, drinks, and alcohol, as well as provides pet foods. Kusuri No Aoki Holdings Co., Ltd. was incorporated in 1999 and is based in Hakusan, Japan.

STUDIO ATAO Co., Ltd. engages in planning and sale of bags and wallets in Japan. The company also manages stores and internet stores; and plans and sells character products. It offers its products the ATAO, ILEMER, IANNE, StrawberryMe, and Atelier Atao brands. STUDIO ATAO Co., Ltd. was incorporated in 2005 and is headquartered in Kobe, Japan.

Dynic Corporation produces and sells fabric and apparel products in Japan. It operates through three segments: Printing Information Related Business, Living Environment Related Business, and Packaging Related Business. It provides materials; publishing, stationery, and fancy products; print media supplies; nonwoven fabric products; apparel products comprising STAFLEX and PANELON fusible interlinings for garments, HARO shaping, and WELDEX interlinings for collars, as well as NIC SEVEN and CETUS care label materials; industrial products; special embossed products; foils, films, and paper products, as well as processed paper, paper tubes, and coating paper; and environmentally friendly products, as well as products for home. The company also offers book binding cloth, cloth for stationery paper goods, various bags/backpacks/purses made from simulated leather, computer ribbons, fine films, cloth for magnetic passbooks, various types of printing materials, business card and postcard printers, and moisture getters for organic ELs. In addition, it provides materials for automobile interiors; filters; fusible interlinings for clothing; and interior decorating items, such as carpets and wallpaper, tarpaulins, aluminum foils, and composite films for food containers. Dynic Corporation was formerly known as Nippon Cloth Industry Co., Ltd. and changed its name to Dynic Corporation in 1974. Dynic Corporation was incorporated in 1919 and is based in Kyoto, Japan.

Kyowa Leather Cloth Co., Ltd. manufactures and sells synthetic leather cover materials in Japan. The company's products are used in automotive interiors, housing and building materials, fashion and lifestyle. It sells its products under the Sobagni brand. Kyowa Leather Cloth Co., Ltd. was incorporated in 1935 and is headquartered in Hamamatsu, Japan.

RenetJapanGroup,Inc. engages in internet reuse, recycling, and social care businesses in Japan and internationally. The company offers used books, CDs, DVDs, video games, game software, branded goods, precious metals, and figurines under the NET OFF brand. It also offers used small electronic devices, etc. under the ReNet.jp brand. In addition, it offers a small home appliance recycling business, utilizing the internet and home delivery services to collect and recycle urban mines, and provides an online platform service for selling renewable resources from collected used small devices, and an automobile advertising business. RenetJapanGroup,Inc. was founded in 1998 and is headquartered in Obu, Japan.

United & Collective Co., Ltd. manages restaurants in Japan. The company also engages in franchise related activities. United & Collective Co., Ltd. was incorporated in 2000 and is headquartered in Tokyo, Japan.

JADE GROUP,Inc engages in the operation of an online shoe and fashion store in Japan. The company operates e-commerce mall sites and various brands. It also provides proprietary logistics and IT infrastructure systems to external brands. In addition, the company is involved in the online sale of women's and men's clothing and leather products; sale of accessories, sporting goods, and daily necessities; publication and sale of books, magazines, and web media; warehouse leasing; and consulting services. The company was formerly known as LOCONDO, Inc. and changed its name to JADE GROUP,Inc in June 2023. JADE GROUP,Inc was incorporated in 2010 and is headquartered in Shibuya, Japan.

p-ban.com Corp. designs, manufactures, and sells printed circuit boards in Japan. It operates p-ban.com, an e-commerce site for printed circuit boards. The company also offers PCB design, manufacturing, and component mounting; parts procurement; and circuit design, development and mass production support, and technical consulting services. It is used in various applications, including automobiles, televisions, smartphones, medical devices, industrial equipment, robots, IoT devices, and more. p-ban.com Corp. was incorporated in 2002 and is headquartered in Chiyoda, Japan.

Hobonichi Co., Ltd. engages in the content production and management of the website Hobonichi in Japan. The company is also involved in the planning, development, and sale of products under the Hobonichi Techo and Hobonichi Earth Ball brands; and planning, development, and operation of apps, such as Hobonichi Gakuen, Dokonoko, and Hobonichi Techo app. In addition, it engages in the planning and management of stores comprising TOBICHI, Hobonichi Sunday, and Hobonoeki AKAGI, as well as events, including Joys of Life Exhibition. Further, the company operates Hobonichi School; Dokonoko, a posting app that connects dogs, cats, and humans; weeksdays, a lifestyle brand; Hobonichi MOTHER Project; Hobonichi Station AKAGI facility; and For Sleepless Bears project. Hobonichi Co., Ltd. was incorporated in 1979 and is headquartered in Chiyoda, Japan.

Chikaranomoto Holdings Co., Ltd., together with its subsidiaries, engages in the operation of ramen specialty stores, restaurants, and food courts. The company operates through three segments: Domestic Store Management Business, Overseas Store Management Business, and Product Sales Business. It manufactures and sells soba, udon, and ramen noodles, as well as soups, sauces, broths, seasonings, and other food ingredients under the Ippudo, Najimatei, Inaba Udon, Kaeda, Kanada, Watanabe Seimen, and RAMEN EXPRESS brand names. The company also provides licenses to local operating partner companies; planning and design support services; and management of various events, technical training classes, and storehouses. It serves commercial and general consumers. Chikaranomoto Holdings Co., Ltd. operates in Japan, the United States, Singapore, China, Hong Kong, Taiwan, Australia, Malaysia, Thailand, the Philippines, Indonesia, the United Kingdom, France, Myanmar, Vietnam, and New Zealand. The company was founded in 1985 and is headquartered in Fukuoka City, Japan.

No.1 Co.,Ltd engages in the planning, development, manufacture, sale, and maintenance of information security equipment and OA related products in Japan. It offers multifunction printers, business phones, and file servers. It also engages in the sale and maintenance of information and communication equipment; wifi devices; develops, manufactures, and sells OEM/ODM supplies; electricity; information security and office equipment; IT engineering; semiconductor; system designs; energy products; call centers; printers; provides network infrastructure, data centers, ICT support services; and application services. The company was incorporated in 1989 and is headquartered in Tokyo, Japan.

Food & Life Companies Ltd. operates a chain of sushi restaurants. It also operates restaurants under Sugidama, Kyotaru, Conveyor Belt Sushi Misaki, Kaisen San, and Sushiro brands. The company was formerly known as Sushiro Global Holdings Ltd. and changed its name to Food & Life Companies Ltd. in April 2021. Food & Life Companies Ltd. was founded in 1975 and is headquartered in Suita, Japan.

Ascentech K.K. engages virtual desktop business in Japan. The company offers virtual desktop infrastructure (VDI) software, VDI server, and VDI printing, as well as network, security, ThinClient, and infrastructure products. It also provides professional services, such as consulting, system design and integration, and support and maintenance services; and cloud services, including Resalio Daas and SafeNet authentication services. Ascentech K.K. was incorporated in 2009 and is headquartered in Chiyoda, Japan.

Uniform Next Co., Ltd. engages in the sale of uniforms to companies, stores, and individuals in Japan. The company offers restaurant uniforms, such as aprons, shirts, pants, T-shirts, and polo shirts, as well as Japanese-style uniforms, such as sakumu uniforms; and kitchen and cooking uniforms, such as cook and lab coats. It also offers work uniforms, such as long-sleeved and short-sleeved blousons, shirts, cargo pants, tsunagi, winter clothing, safety shoes, air-conditioned clothing, rain gear, and other workwear for construction, ironwork, electrical engineering, agricultural work, manufacturing plants, transportation warehouses, and delivery sales. The company's medical uniforms include nurse and doctor uniforms, such as nurse wear, dresses, scrubs, examination gowns, and casey lab coats; and office uniforms include jackets, skirts, overblouses, shirts, cut-and-sew, vests, scarves, skirts, culottes, pants, dresses, and accessories for reception, information, customer service, sales, field work, office work, and medical office work, such as hospitals and nursing homes, and companions. It offers its products through mail order and door-to-door sales. Uniform Next Co., Ltd. was incorporated in 1994 and is headquartered in Fukui, Japan.

Seiren Co.,Ltd. manufactures and markets textile products, industrial machines, and electronic parts in Japan and internationally. The company operates through five segments: Vehicle Upholstery Materials, High Fashion Materials, Electronics Materials, Environmental & Life Materials, and Medical Materials. The Vehicle Materials segment offers interior materials for automobiles, railway cars, etc., as well as seat materials, air bags, and decorative parts. The High Fashion Materials segment engages in textile processing, and various clothing products. The Electronics Materials segment offers conductive materials, industrial wiping cloths, Viscotecs systems and supply, wafer deposition and processing, artificial satellites; electronic devices, film deposition on silicon wafer. The Environmental & Life Materials provides building materials, interior materials, health and care products, and environmental/civil engineering materials. The Medical Materials offers medical supplies, cosmetics, and water treatment materials. It provides digital production systems; and civil engineering, construction, and industrial materials. The company also offers environmentally-friendly materials; beauty/health care materials; medical/nursing care materials; and life/interior materials. In addition, it engages in the automotive interior, clothing materials, and textile finishing materials businesses, as well as provides sales promotion. The company was formerly known as Fukui Seiren Kako Co., Ltd. and changed its name to Seiren Co.,Ltd. in 1973. Seiren Co.,Ltd. was founded in 1889 and is headquartered in Minato, Japan.

Sotoh Co., Ltd. engages in the dyeing and processing of woolen, composite fiber, and knitted fabrics in Japan. The company provides textile and synthetic fiber dyeing and processing services; produces brushed and glossy fabrics; and manufactures and sells textile products. It also engages in the real estate business. The company was incorporated in 1923 and is headquartered in Ichinomiya, Japan.

KOMATSU MATERE Co.,Ltd. engages in the planning, development, manufacturing, and sale of synthetic fabrics and thin film fabrics in Japan and internationally. The company operates through Textile and Other Business segments. It is involved in the manufacture and sale of fabrics various apparel including fashion clothing, sportswear, and uniforms, as well as highly performance fabrics for a range of applications, including interiors, automotive interior materials, medical and welfare equipment, and electrical materials; and plan, propose, manufacture, and sell original products in the fields of fashion clothing, and sports wear. The company also offers Bellefomer, a sludge reduction bioformulation; CABKOMA, a carbon fiber composite and thermoplastic resin; mono-bo, sell bags and lifestyle goods. The company was formerly known as KOMATSU SEIREN Co.,Ltd. and changed its name to KOMATSU MATERE Co.,Ltd. in October 2018. KOMATSU MATERE Co.,Ltd. was incorporated in 1943 and is headquartered in Nomi, Japan.

AuBEX CORPORATION manufactures and sells nibs and medical equipment in Japan and internationally. The company offers nibs made from chemical fibers, plastics, and other material; medical equipment and components, such as pressure infusion devices and angiography guide wires; and nibs for makeup and cosmetics products. The company was formerly known as Tokyo hat Co., Ltd. and changed its name to AuBEX CORPORATION in 1985. AuBEX CORPORATION was founded in 1892 and is headquartered in Tokyo, Japan.

Wacoal Holdings Corp. engages in the manufacturing, wholesale, and retail sale of intimate apparel, outerwear, sportswear, and other textile products and accessories in Japan, Asia, Oceania, the United States, and Europe. The company operates through Wacoal Business (Domestic), Wacoal Business (Overseas), Peach John Business, and Other Businesses segments. It offers intimate apparel, including women's foundation wear, lingerie, nightwear and children's underwear. The company is also involved in the retail sale of products; manufacture and wholesale distribution women's innerwear, lace, and fabrics for handicrafts; leasing of real estate; apparel manufacturing; other textile-related business. It offers products through department stores, general merchandisers, and other general retailers, as well as directly managed retail stores, E-commerce websites, and distributors. Wacoal Holdings Corp. was founded in 1946 and is headquartered in Kyoto, Japan.

FUJIX Ltd. manufactures, distributes, and trades in various sewing and embroidery thread in Japan, Asia, and internationally. It offers industrial sewing, special use, decorative, machine embroidery, and other threads. The company also provides home-use sewing threads, such as synthetic fiber sewing, cotton sewing, silk sewing, special use, lock sewing, patchwork, decorative, temari, and other threads, as well as polyester and bobbin threads for embroidery. It serves the apparel, fashion, and related handicraft industries. The company was founded in 1921 and is headquartered in Kyoto, Japan.

TSI Holdings Co.,Ltd. engages in the planning, manufacture, and sale of clothing in Japan and internationally. It is also involved in the general lifestyle business; planning, manufacture, and sale of fashion, accessories, and furniture, as well as planning, purchasing, and wholesale of overseas brands; import, wholesale, and sale of cosmetics, perfumes, soaps, quasi-drugs, and clothing; and employment placement and worker dispatch businesses. In addition, the company engages in the web service development, design, and operation business; and media, advertising, and service sales agency businesses.
