GMO GlobalSign Holdings K.K. provides digital authentication and electronic signature technologies to government agencies and enterprises worldwide. It operates through Digital Certificate and eSignature, Cloud Infrastructure, and Digital Transformation segments. The company provides issue, corporate actuality authentication, and country of authentication ASP, as well as digital media, marketing, and devices. Its solutions support technologies, such as AI, IoT, and blockchain. The company was formerly known as GMO Cloud K.K. and changed its name to GMO GlobalSign Holdings K.K. in September 2020. The company was incorporated in 1993 and is based in Tokyo, Japan. GMO GlobalSign Holdings K.K. is a subsidiary of GMO internet group, Inc.

Drecom Co.,Ltd. engages in game, media, and merchandise businesses in Japan. It is involved in technology solution business, including AI, infrastructure solutions, location data game development support, fan marketing, and Web3; publishing business; merchandise business; and handles webtoons, anime, light-novels, comics, and cross-media under the Drecom Media brand name. The company was incorporated in 2001 and is headquartered in Tokyo, Japan.

e-Seikatsu Co.,Ltd. provides cloud-based software and applications in Japan. It offers real estate business support solutions as Software as a Service (SaaS) on a subscription basis. The company also provides solution services, including setup, implementation, and operation support for SaaS, contract development of system and application, sales agency and intermediary services; and consulting services. It serves real estate companies. The company was incorporated in 2000 and is headquartered in Minato, Japan.

ULS Group, Inc. provides consulting and contract development services related to information systems in Japan. The company also provides IT architecture consulting services. In addition, the company develops technical verification activities related to new consulting services, human resource development services, and software architecture platform construction. It serves companies in the finance, information and communications, service, and manufacturing industries, as well as local governments and other public entities. The company was formerly known as UL Systems, Inc. and changed its name to ULS Group, Inc. in October 2011. ULS Group, Inc. was incorporated in 2000 and is headquartered in Tokyo, Japan.

Keyware Solutions Inc. develops and sells information systems for the support of social infrastructure in Japan. It offers medical service systems to various medical services divisions, such as examination, nutrition, medical professions, and clinic management analysis systems; transportation operations, includes fare collection, train station revenue administration, settlement with other train lines, and IC cards; social infrastructure solutions; public traffic systems, such as new traffic management and train operation information network systems; passengers-related information systems, including train approaching status displays and destination guide displays, as well as train seat reservation system; and mass media related solutions. The company also provides communication data for fixed phones and mobile phones, packet communication data, customer management, rate management, billing administration, collection administration, and linkage and backbone systems; and air traffic and monitoring control management systems, as well as mobile telecommunications. In addition, it offers various solutions, including ERP, productivity improvement consulting service, digital transformation solution; cloud-based solutions; support services, including creation, implementation, operation, maintenance, and training services; and system integration services, as well as sells hardware, systems, package software products, and related supplies. It offers its products and services for use in financial services, distribution and logistics, manufacturing, telecommunications, transportation, media, government agencies, medical services, network administration, system monitoring, transmission control, and interface control fields, as well as for service providers. The company was formerly known as Nippon Electronics Development Co., Ltd. and changed its name to Keyware Solutions Inc. in January 2001. Keyware Solutions Inc. was founded in 1965 and is headquartered in Shinjuku, Japan.

UNIRITA Inc. provides software and solutions for information technology (IT) systems operation in Japan and internationally. The company offers CommuRing; LMIS; Ranabase; Serccs; Report & Form warehouse; Digital Workforce; Waha!Transformer; A-AUTO; auttit; A-LOG; A-SPOOL; BSP-RM; XRF; EXTES plus; Connect CDC; QUICK-EDD/HA; QUICK-EcoSAVEi; QUICK-Justi; QUICK-Hawk_i for IT department that manage information systems. It also provides SecuAiGent; Growwwing; bindit; CommuRing; Ranabase; Serccs for business divisions for back-office functions such as general affairs and accounting, and corporate divisions for management and planning. In addition, the company offers STORE+; Community MaaS for retail businesses with multiple stores or agriculture. Further, it is involved in development and sales of products and services related to corporate data utilization and system operation, development of related systems, and consulting services. UNIRITA Inc. was incorporated in 1982 and is headquartered in Minato, Japan.

Ecomic Co., Ltd engages in BPO and other businesses in Japan. The company offers cloud-based payroll bonus calculation services; and proposing service requirements, supporting business process improvement, and handling administrative tasks. It also provides cloud-based year-end tax adjustment services; resident tax related services; and my number collection services. In addition, the company offers system development services, as well as time attendance and personnel system; and cloud-based human resources management system. Further, it provides contracted services for issuing and verifying discount coupons for restaurants. The company was incorporated in 1997 and is headquartered in Sapporo, Japan.

System D Inc. develops and sells industry specific package software products in Japan. The company offers Campus plan, a solution that supports school operations; School Engine, a cloud-based system for school affairs; PPP public accounting system, a local government accounting package software; Public Asset Management, a system for the management of local government assets; Common, a financial accounting system for local governments; and Smart Hello, a solution to support operations at amusement parks, zoos, and other tourist attractions. It also provides soft engineering services and solutions, including regulation management, and contract creation and management systems. The company was formerly known as Gendai Kobosha Co., Ltd. and changed its name to System D Inc. in June 1984. System D Inc. was incorporated in 1982 and is headquartered in Kyoto, Japan.

FISCO Ltd. provides investment support services in Japan. It offers information services, IR consulting; advertising and creative services. The company was founded in 1994 and is headquartered in Minato, Japan.

Media Kobo, Inc. engages in the provision of digital content services in Japan and internationally. The company plans, produces, and distributes fortune-telling and article content mainly aimed at women through its websites, mobile communication carriers, and platforms such as Apple and Google; provides one-on-one service that connects users and fortune tellers directly via phone or chat; and plans, produces, and operates in-house developed applications. It is also involved in filming and content production contracting services, as well as promoting IP alliances with other companies. The company offers its services for the multifunctional social platform for web communication. Media Kobo, Inc. was incorporated in 1997 and is headquartered in Tokyo, Japan.

Daiwa Computer Co., Ltd. engages in the software development and service integration businesses in Japan. The company engages in the construction and operation of information systems, system and software design, development, implementation, and maintenance; and consultation on software development, process improvement, and CMMI implementation. The company provides SaaS-based software services and related system and software consulting, design, development, installation, maintenance, and hardware sales and installation. In addition, it engages in the production, processing, and sales of agricultural products; and production, processing, transportation, and sales of tomatoes. Further, the company offers cloud services, RFID services, and i-Agriculture, an agricultural automation technology. Daiwa Computer Co., Ltd. was incorporated in 1977 and is headquartered in Takatsuki, Japan.

SRA Holdings, Inc. engages in the provision of IT consulting, system construction, operation services, products, and solutions in Japan and internationally. It offers systems development services, which includes financial, embedded, and academic IT services, as well as business systems development, infrastructure development, and consulting services; operation/administration services comprising outsourcing, infrastructure operation, and system operation services; and product solutions marketing services consist of internal controls, cloud security, AI, BI, open source software, academia, development support, system quality, and healthcare services. The company also provides Cavirin, a compliance and security solution for the hybrid cloud; UniVision, a web services-based integrated university administration solution incorporating a range of academic systems, including Student Portfolio System and DB Spiral university information database system; PowerGres, a tool and support for database operation; and HEALTHPLAYER, a service platform for acquisition and analysis of various health care data. In addition, it offers P-Con, a paperless solution that enables as-is digitization of existing paper documents; MailDepot, a mail archiving product; ProjDepot, which provides consolidated management of projects across the organization, supports secure, and management of software assets; TestDepot, an embedded software development tool that supports automation of testing tasks; and Testablish that offers automated testing for GUI applications. The company was incorporated in 1991 and is headquartered in Tokyo, Japan.

long_name: THE WHY HOW DO COMPANY, Inc.
business_summary: THE WHY HOW DO COMPANY, Inc. provides services and solutions for smartphones in Japan. It develops platform solutions for smartphones and IoT related solutions; and handles social games and app-related services, and other contract development projects. It also operates a real estate sublease store in the Tokyo metropolitan area; and provides training for job seekers. In addition, the company engages in the music production and concert activities; planning, production, and performance of various events, including plays, entertainment shows, lectures, and sports; and management, licensing, and sale of intellectual property rights. The company was formerly known as Acrodea, Inc. and changed its name to THE WHY HOW DO COMPANY, Inc. in January 2022. THE WHY HOW DO COMPANY, Inc. was incorporated in 2004 and is headquartered in Tokyo, Japan.

Remixpoint, Inc. engages in the development and sale of energy management systems and energy-saving support consulting services in Japan. The company operates through four segments: Energy Business, Resilience Business, Financial Investment Business, and Others. It also provides electric power retail services, energy saving and subsidy support and consulting, energy management, and zero energy building services; and sells storage batteries for home use and infectious disease prevention products. Further, it provides antibacterial/antiviral coating, lighting strike suppression lighting, MA-T visualization of closed/dense, water dispenser, spatial environment improvement, AI face recognition and body temperature detection, and power supply. Additionally, the company offers services related to cryptocurrency investment, stock investment, and loans, as well as marketing consulting services. Remixpoint, Inc. was incorporated in 2004 and is based in Tokyo, Japan.

System Integrator Corp. plans, develops, and sells packaging software and cloud services in Japan. It offers ERP, production management tools, development support tools, project management tools, etc.; AI-based products and services; and provision, support, and consulting of AI-related solutions. The company's products include SI Object Browser, a database development support tool; SI Object Browser ER, an ER diagram creation tool; OBPMneo, a project management tools; GRANDIT, an integrated web-ERP; miraimil, an integrated cloud ERP; SAP, a cloud ERP from a management perspective; ASPROVA, a production scheduler; mc frame, an integrated business system that supports production management, sales management, and cost management; Streamline, an integrated SCM solution; and KENZ, a map inspection AI. System Integrator Corp. was incorporated in 1995 and is headquartered in Saitama, Japan.

Asahi Net, Inc. operates as an internet connection service provider in Japan. The company offers manaba, a learning management system for universities; AiSTRIX, a cloud-based camera solution; Omakase router, providing router rental service, support desk, configuration and maintenance support offered to retail, restaurant and service industries; and v6 Connect, a roaming service using native protocol IPv6 internet connection for telecommunication operators. The company was formerly known as ATSON, Inc. and changed its name to Asahi Net, Inc. in January 2001. Asahi Net, Inc. was incorporated in 1990 and is headquartered in Tokyo, Japan.

eBase Co.,Ltd. engages in the planning, development, sale, and maintenance of content management software in Japan. The company offers Middleware eBASE, a comprehensive data management software; industry specific software for food, daily necessities, and housing industries; optional software for eBASE servers; and other software solutions. It also offers daily goods industry, housing industry, data pool, printing industry, sales support, data management, business agreement, order system, product planning and development, and complaint information management solutions. In addition, the company develops middleware solutions. eBase Co.,Ltd. was incorporated in 2001 and is headquartered in Osaka, Japan.

Avant Group Corporation, through its subsidiaries, provides accounting, business intelligence, and outsourcing services in Japan. The company develops and maintains DivaSystem, a package software for consolidated management and accounting. It also provides information search services; systems integration services for business intelligence; support services for implementing cloud data platforms; sales and maintenance of software licenses and hardware; and outsourcing services for consolidated accounting, consolidated financial statement disclosure business, as well as digital transformation promotion project. In addition, the company engages in the development and sales of disclosure information and regulation search engine; BI/DWH consulting and integration and sale of packages; outsourcing of consolidated and non-consolidated financial closing operations; and provision of management consulting services. Avant Group Corporation was incorporated in 1997 and is based in Tokyo, Japan.

Ad-Sol Nissin Corporation develops information and embedded systems for companies in Japan. The company provides IoT products and solutions, including proprietary electric field communication devices; SUNMAP, a geographic information system (GIS) solution for the effective use of customer information assets; provide one-stop security enhancement support services. It also offers wireless communications, cloud technology, and development support services. The company is also involved in development and operation management of systems in social infrastructure fields, including energy sectors such as electricity and gas as well as automobiles, roads, railway, air transport disaster prevention, information communications, and payment services. Ad-Sol Nissin Corporation was founded in 1976 and is headquartered in Minato, Japan.

ODK Solutions Company, Ltd. provides information processing outsourcing services in Japan. The company provides entrance exam solutions, such as online application system and entrance examination outsourcing services; and operates UCARO, a university entrance exam portal site. It also offers educational app development; and securities trading solutions. In addition, the company provides SLAP and iStudy LMS e-learning platforms that support human resource development; develops, sells, and operates e-learning materials, as well as e-learning, on-demand learning, and corporate training services; and provides customer support and medical solutions, including clinical testing systems. Further, it develops and sells software; provides information provision services. Additionally, the company serves educational institutions, securities companies, general business corporations, etc. ODK Solutions Company, Ltd. was incorporated in 1963 and is headquartered in Osaka, Japan.

VIXTON Corporation manufactures and retails cosmetics and wellness products through e-commerce and other channels. The company offers cosmetics and beauty products under the Ex:BEAUTE brand, along with wellness and regenerative medicine products. It also engages in the research, development, and sale of microalgae and related extracts, and manufactures and sells human-derived cosmetic raw materials. Additionally, the company provides biomass power generation services. VIXTON Corporation distributes its products through distributors, retailers, and direct-to-consumer channels. VIXTON Corporation was formerly known as Path Corporation and changed its name to VIXTON Corporation in September 2026. VIXTON Corporation was incorporated in 1990 and is based in Tokyo, Japan.

Jedat Inc. develops, distributes, and sells electronic design automation (EDA) software for circuit and layout design worldwide. The company offers software products, primarily for the design of large-scale integrated circuits (LSI), flat panel displays (FPD), and microfabricated components such as magnetic heads and microelectromechanical systems (MEMS). The company also provides LSI design, flat panel display design, fine pattern design, and PCB and package design services; EDA tools for SoC design; and SX-Meister, an EDA system. In addition, the company offers analog and display solutions. The company was founded in 1980 and is headquartered in Chuo, Japan.

Nextgen,Inc. provides telecommunication, session initiation protocol (SIP)/VoIP security, and enterprise solutions in Japan. The company offers NX-B5000, a software border controller; direct route for microsoft teams; NX-C1000, a class 5 softswitch; and HSS/HLR solutions. It also offers NX-C6000/NX-C6500, a network forensic and IDS system targeted for VoIP/IMS core network; VoIP QA testing solution; SIP/VoIP security audit; and voice logging solutions. The company was incorporated in 2001 and is headquartered in Tokyo, Japan.

FreeBit Co., Ltd. operates as a supporting Internet business, and broadband business company. The company operates through the 5G Infrastructure Support Project, 5G Lifestyles Support Business, and Companies and Creators 5G DX Support Business segments. The 5G Infrastructure Support Project segment uses artificial intelligence and blockchain to provide a business platform. The 5G Lifestyles Support Business segment provides business platforms for safe and secure ways of working and housing, real estate-related services, and web-related platforms. The Companies and Creators 5G DX Support Business segment engages in building platform for maintaining relations with customers. In addition, it offers network business for internet service providers. Further, the company offers mobile virtual network enabler, mobile virtual network operator, and cloud businesses, as well as a network consulting business. FreeBit Co., Ltd. was incorporated in 2000 and is headquartered in Tokyo, Japan.

Comture Corporation provides cloud, digital, business, platform and operation, and digital learning solutions in Japan. It offers cloud services, such as collaboration and CRM; and consulting, and integration services. The company also provides analysis solutions using big data and AI tools, as well as support services for the automation of business processes. In addition, it engages in the construction, operation, modernization and consulting of accounting, human resources, fintech, and other core systems. Further, the company is involved in the design, construction, and operation of virtual network environment; remote surveillance of IT systems; and help desk operation activities. Additionally, it offers education services using various online platforms; and IT training services. Comture Corporation was incorporated in 1985 and is headquartered in Tokyo, Japan.

I-Freek Mobile Inc. engages in the digital transformation business in Japan and internationally. The company operates through Content Business and DX Business segments. It involves planning, producing, and operating educational apps and digital picture book services, characters, picture book videos, AI-powered web applications, and support IP deployment. In addition, the company provides IT engineer dispatch and contract work services. I-Freek Mobile Inc. was founded in 2000 and is based in Shinjuku, Japan.

Data Applications Company, Limited engages in software development, sales, and consulting related to corporate internal and external data linkage in Japan. The company's product portfolio comprises enterprise data link infrastructure; B2B server for digital business transactions; iPaaS for EDI and Data Integration; Web-based data exchange system architecture tools; full automation of browser functions for Web-EDI; TCP/IP banking systems; data-handling platforms; non-programming data exchange tools; and EDI client for small and medium-sized businesses. Data Applications Company, Limited was incorporated in 1982 and is headquartered in Chuo, Japan.

NTT Data Intramart Corporation provides software products and services in Japan. The company operates through two segments, Software Business and Service Business. The company develops and sells provision of annual licenses and maintenance of packages; web system construction platforms; and cloud services. It also provides consultation services for construction of web systems using intra-mart products, package software to construct web system bases. The company was founded in 1998 and is headquartered in Tokyo, Japan.

Nippon Ichi Software, Inc. develops and sells computer software in Japan, Asia, North America, Europe, and other countries. It operates through Entertainment Business, and Student Dormitories and Other Businesses segments. The company offers home video game software; and game content for mobile phones and smartphones. It also manages student dormitories; and invests in real estate properties. The company was incorporated in 1995 and is headquartered in Kakamigahara, Japan.

Asteria Corporation develops and sells software in Japan. The company offers ASTERIA Warp, a digital linkage tool for the automation of operations; Handbook X, a digital organization app; Platio, a mobile app creation tool for the creation of business apps; Gravio, an integrated edge platform for no-code AI and IoT; Artefacts, a continuous integration platform for robotic application development; SnapCal, which provides integration for Google calendar, tasks, and iOS calendar; and lino, a sticky and canvas service. It also provides product support, consulting, and training services. The company was incorporated in 1998 and is headquartered in Shibuya, Japan.

I'LL inc. operates as a system solution business in Japan. The company operates in two segments, system solutions and web solutions. The System Solutions Business segment provides services, including network construction and security management; store management services for the fashion industry; educational services, such as IT and OA literacy education, engineer training, support for obtaining qualifications, and business skills training, as well as develops systems for other industries, including fashion, food, and medical equipment. The web solutions segment offers web materials such as EC site construction, multiple online shop central management software, and website production and utilization support. The company was incorporated in 1991 and is headquartered in Osaka, Japan.

Abalance Corporation, together with its subsidiaries, engages in renewable energy, construction machinery, IT, and photocatalyst businesses in Japan and internationally. It also engages in the manufacturing of solar panel, sale of solar power generation systems, electricity, and related products; development of solar modules and system; provides materials for industrial and residential storage batteries; and offers photocatalyst- related liquids. It is also involved in the sale, lease, and rental of construction equipment and machinery. In addition, the company is involved in sale and rental of hydrogen energy storage systems, as well as the development of storage systems. The company was formerly known as REALCOM Inc. and changed its name to Abalance Corporation in March 2017. Abalance Corporation was incorporated in 2000 and is headquartered in Tokyo, Japan.

Ubiquitous AI Corporation develops and sells embedded software products primarily in Japan and internationally. The company offers various products, including Ubiquitous Securus, an anti-tamper security solution for embedded devices; Ubiquitous TPM Security, a security software solution for trusted platform module; Edge Trust, a solution for enabling secure IoT services; Ubiquitous Network Framework, a TCP/IP stack-based middleware; Ubiquitous DTCP, a link protection middleware; and Ubiquitous HDCP, a software development kit optimized for HDCP implementation. It also provides Ubiquitous WPA/WPS/Wi-Fi Direct, a software development kit for developing the functionalities necessary for wireless LAN clients to acquire the Wi-Fi certification logo; Ubiquitous QuickBoot, a fast boot solution for Linux and Android; Ubiquitous DeviceSQL, a data management software for embedded systems; and Ubiquitous USB host platform. In addition, the company offers Ubiquitous Miracast Solution, a wireless environment software for remote display connection; Ubiquitous ECHONET Lite, a middleware software; Ubiquitous Wi-SMART, a middleware software; Ubiquitous TLS/SSL, a security protocol; TOPPERS-Pro Series, an RTOS solution package; and Ubiquitous DLNA SDK, a middleware software. Further, it imports and sells software products; and provides technical support and customize development services. The company offers software analysis and development efficiency tools, security products, and support services related to its offerings. Its services include software development, distribution, and sales of data content licenses, as well as the design and production of various software, primarily contracted software for thin-film applications. The company was formerly known as Ubiquitous Corporation and changed its name to Ubiquitous AI Corporation in July 2018 operations. Ubiquitous AI Corporation was incorporated in 2001 and is headquartered in Tokyo, Japan.

Oji Holdings Corporation manufactures and sells pulp and paper products in Japan, China, rest of Asia, North and South America, Europe, Oceania, and internationally. The Household and Industrial Materials segment offers corrugated containers, containerboard, special paperboard, boxboards, packaging paper, liquid paper cartons, filters, folding cartons, kraft heavy-duty sacks, insulation, paper bags, paper cores, and plastic trays. This segment also provides facial tissues, toilet rolls, kitchen and hand towels, wet disinfecting wipes, masks, towels, incontinence aid products, nursing care products/disposable diapers, skincare products, products for professional use, and other nursing care products. Its Functional Materials segment offers food containers and packaging materials, functional films, functional materials for manufacturing and industrial use, agricultural materials, medical and hygiene-related materials, thermal paper, non-woven fabric, adhesive base paper, release liner sheets, printing and publication paper, and writing and office supplies, as well as specialty paper. The Forest Resources and Environment Marketing segment provides pulp, lumber, electric power, starch, and saccharified products, as well as afforestation and lumber processing services. Its Printing and Communications Media segment provides newsprints, printing and publication papers, and communication papers. The company also engages in the trading, sustainable packaging, logistics, engineering, real estate, and liquid packaging carton businesses; and provision of cellulose nanofiber and cellulose-related products, CellArray-Heart cell culture substrate for controlled cell orientation, oji licorice, and PaPiPress products. The company was formerly known as Oji Paper Co., Ltd. and changed its name to Oji Holdings Corporation in October 2012. Oji Holdings Corporation was founded in 1873 and is headquartered in Chuo, Japan.

Nippon Paper Industries Co., Ltd. engages in the production and sale of pulp and paper products in Japan, Oceania, Asia, North America, and internationally. It offers paper products, including printing and writing, business communication, wrapping, functional specialty, and converting papers; newsprints; household paper and professional products, which comprise facial and bath tissue, paper towels, pre-moistened and industrial-use wipes, and personal-care products; health care products; paper-based materials under the SHIELDPLUS brand; and paper straws. The company also provides kitchen products; kraft and dissolving pulps; cellulose nanofiber; agriculture products, such as seedlings; plywood and laminated lumber products; and other products comprising Cu-TOP copper ion-loaded cellulose and wet non-woven fabric, as well as a shelf-life-extending agent under the Wasa Green brand. In addition, it offers chemicals, including sulfite dissolving pulp, functional chemicals, lignin products, ribonucleic acid/yeast products, functional coating resin, and optical films for display devices. Further, the company is involved in the energy business and construction-related business. The company was incorporated in 1949 and is headquartered in Chiyoda, Japan.

Mitsubishi Paper Mills Limited develops and sell products in the fields of functional nonwoven fabrics, electronics, medical, and healthcare in Japan, Europe, Asia, North America, and internationally. It offers graphic arts materials; air filters; polymer membrane core; aramid-reinforced, celulose based non-woven, polyester non-woven, and coating separators; glass paper, liquid filter media, and offset printable nonwoven fabric products; and fireproof glass fiber products, as well as rewritable thermal recording materials. The company also provides photo media, proofing media, sign and display media, and inkjet papers. In addition, it offers printing, sanitary, packing, carbonless, copier, tape base, sterilization, and decorative laminate base papers; water treatment membrane support substrate; and paperboard and pulp. The company was formerly known as Mitsubishi Paper Mills Company and changed its name to Mitsubishi Paper Mills Limited in November 1917. Mitsubishi Paper Mills Limited was incorporated in 1898 and is headquartered in Tokyo, Japan.

Hokuetsu Corporation manufactures and sells paper products in Japan, the rest of Asia, North America, and internationally. It operates through Pulp and Paper Business, Packaging and Paper Processing Business, and Other segments. The company is also involved in the manufacture and sale of paper containers and liquid containers, as well as manufacture, processing, and sale of processed paper products; and wood material, construction, logistics, and used paper wholesale businesses. In addition, it acts as sales and distribution agent; manufacturing and sale of vulcanized fiber products and paper, glass fiber sheets, liquid package cartons and packaging, laminated paper and related materials; cutting, selecting, packing and loading/unloading of the company's products; industrial wastewater purification processing and waste disposal; and supply of steam and electric power, and computer-related components. Further, the company engages in mailing business; processing and sale of carrier tape for precision electronic parts; manufacturing and sale of industrial machinery and electric instrumentation construction; design and construction of civil engineering and buildings; provision of transportation and warehousing services; and import and sales of vulcanized fiber and AGM battery separator. The company was formerly known as Hokuetsu Kishu Paper Co., Ltd. and changed its name to Hokuetsu Corporation in July 2018. Hokuetsu Corporation was incorporated in 1907 and is headquartered in Tokyo, Japan.

Minoya Co., Ltd. engages in the sale of confectionery products through retail stores under the Okashino Machioka name. It offers various sweets, pastries, snacks, rice crackers, and biscuits. The company was incorporated in 1954 and is based in Saitama, Japan.

Chuetsu Pulp & Paper Co., Ltd. manufactures, processes, and sells pulp, paper, and by-products in Japan and internationally. It operates through two segments: Paper and Pulp Manufacturing Business and Power Generation Business segments. The company offers printing, information, wrapping, processing, base, specialty, and bamboo papers, as well as newspapers and paper bags, paper tubes, cardboards, and paperboards. The company is also involved in the forestry, sawmilling, and processing and trading of timber, as well as construction of greening projects; manufacture, processing, and trading of chemicals; buying, selling, leasing, managing, and brokering real estate, as well as operating sports facilities; mining, electricity supply and transportation, as well as warehousing. In addition, the company engages in the supply of raw materials, cutting and sorting of products, separate packaging, and logistics; manufactures and sells cellulose and nanofiber related products, wood chips, pulp, and Mapuka related products; designs mechanical equipment; construction and repair; insurance agency; and afforestation and wastewater treatment chemicals. Chuetsu Pulp & Paper Co., Ltd. was incorporated in 1947 and is headquartered in Chuo, Japan.

Tomoegawa Corporation engages in the manufacture, process, and sale of electronics parts, display parts, fine particles, functional sheets, and specialty paper products primarily in Japan. The company offers heat, electricity, electromagnetic wave control related products, such as high performance heat sink and planar heater, heat resistant removable adhesive tape, and thermal conductive insulation adhesive sheet, as well as high insulation adhesive tape; and electronics parts, including lead frame fixing tapes, adhesive tapes, electrode coating, and electrostatic chucks, as well as adhesives for hermetic seal packages. It also provides display products, such as optical adhesive and light control films; fine particle materials, including magnetic toners, non-magnetic toners, full color toners, and new development toners; record printing sheets comprising inkjet, laser printer, sublimation printer paper, and thermal recording paper; magnetic recording sheets consisting of magnetic passenger ticket and special fiber sheets, including inorganic fiber and fluorine fiber sheets, as well as calcium carbonate paper. In addition, the company offers optical plug assembly cleaner and refractive index matching film; insulating paper for cables and transformers; industrial paper, such as conductive paper, water absorption paper, and sterilizing paper; and sound transmission sheets, optical connector cleaner, cellulose fiber compound, copper and stainless fiber sheet, functional powder holding sheet, and conversion sheet. Further, it engages in the manufacturing and sale of cards, documents, magnetic recording-related products, etc., as well as engages in information processing-related businesses; and real estate leasing and logistics services. Tomoegawa Corporation was founded in 1914 and is headquartered in Tokyo, Japan.

Fuller, Inc. offers business development and digital consultancy services in Japan. The company develops applications for mobile devices and offers App Ape, an app analytics service that provides the actual usage application data of smartphones. It also offers services, such as app development, UI/UX design, system development, and application usage data analysis with a focus on smartphone applications, and human resource development support. The company was incorporated in 2011 and is headquartered in Niigata, Japan.

Daio Paper Corporation engages in paper and paperboard business Japan, East Asia, Southeast Asia, Brazil, and internationally. It operates through Paper and Paperboard Home and Personal Care, and Others segments. The company offers newsprint, publication paper, printing paper, communication paper, recycled-content colored construction paper, wrapping paper; containerboard and corrugated container; functional materials; and home and personal care products, such as disposable diapers for babies and adults, sanitary napkins, absorbent liners for light incontinence, various tissue products, wet wipes, and cleaning supplies. It is also involved in research and development of cellulose nanofiber. Daio Paper Corporation was incorporated in 1943 and is headquartered in Shikokuchuo, Japan.

Nippon Kodoshi Corporation manufactures and sells separators in Japan and internationally. The company offers separators for low, medium, and high voltage aluminum electrolytic capacitors; conductive polymer solid capacitors; hybrid capacitors; cellulion separators for lithium-ion batteries; and electric double-layer capacitors and lithium-ion capacitors. It also provides post-lithium-ion batteries. The company was incorporated in 1941 and is headquartered in Kochi, Japan.

Havix Corporation engages in the non-woven fabric and paper related businesses in Japan. It offers raw and processed pulp nonwoven fabrics; synthetic fiber nonwoven fabrics; and sanitary paper, such as disposable diapers and wet towels. The company was incorporated in 1950 and is headquartered in Gifu, Japan.

Awa Paper & Technological Company, Inc. manufactures and sells functional papers and non-woven fabrics in Japan, Thailand, China, rest of Asia, the United States, and internationally. The company offers automotive filter papers, clutch plate friction papers, membrane support fabrics, and battery separator papers; m-fine submerged membrane for membrane bio-reactor products, which include modules, units, wastewater treatment system packages, and microbial solutions, as well as after-sales services consisting of remote monitoring and maintenance; thermal management materials comprising M-thermo high thermal conductive, M-thermo heat conductive, and M-thermo thermal insulation materials; carbon composite materials consisting of carbon and activated carbon fiber sheets, activated carbon sheets, carbon fiber reinforced plastics, and graphite sheets; synthetic fiber papers, including polyester and polyolefin sheets; and air, oil, fuel, and nano coat filter media, as well as filter media for brewery, dry cleaning, and electronic discharge machining. It also provides inorganic powder paper comprising base papers for gaskets and meerschaum sheets; air conditioning management materials consisting of base papers for humidifiers and dehumidifiers; high performance fiber paper, including aramid sheets; and low-density thick paper products, such as cushion and impregnated papers. In addition, the company offers engine filter media; food grade paper; and functional paper for electrical and electronic components products. Its products are used in various applications, such as liquid processing, gas processing, engines, automobiles, industrial, information and communication, building materials, air conditioning, home electronics, agricultural use, and general consumer goods. Awa Paper & Technological Company, Inc. was founded in 1916 and is headquartered in Tokushima, Japan.

CrowdWorks Inc. provides Internet services for crowdsourcing in Japan. The company operates CrowdWorks, a crowdsourcing platform that connects companies with individuals over the Internet enabling orders to be placed and accepted for work; and management support services. It also offers TechDirect, a matching platform that offers high-skilled IT personnel; CrowsLinks, a specialized side job/second business matching service for high-value professionals; CrowdLog, a cloud-based man-hours and project management tool that collects employee man-hours and visualizes how companies work; and Human & Human, an organizational analysis tool specialized in the aggregation and analysis of employee data. In addition, the company provides a job matching registration service for IT freelancers; an AI tool to generate images and articles with sensible operations; an AI offline learning school; online school for side hustles and freelancers; PARK, an EC creation service; MemberPay, a payment service that allows online sales of fixed monthly fees and one-time services with no initial or monthly fees; and online community for freelancers and secondary jobs. CrowdWorks Inc. was incorporated in 2011 and is headquartered in Tokyo, Japan.

KAYAC Inc. engages in the digital content business in Japan. The company offers SNS marketing and web promotion planning and development services; research and development, service planning and development, and product planning and development services; event planning and development services; branding services; utilizing gamification services; and sustainable development goals services. It also provides in-house game development, such as social games and hyper casual games; game and anime related contract development; production of the Metaverse; system and application development, as well as DX promotion; tournament platform under the Tonamel brand; and planning and management of gaming and e-sports events and tournaments, and related services. In addition, the company offers online gaming tutoring services; and community currency to local governments and businesses. Further, it is involved in wedding-related business; real estate business; and funeral business. KAYAC Inc. was founded in 1998 and is headquartered in Kamakura, Japan.

Datasection Inc. provides AI data center/AI cloud, data science, marketing solutions, and system integration services in Japan, Chile, and Colombia. Its services include data infrastructe, consultiong, data analysis, education and human resource development; Insight Intelligence Q, a tool that allows to search and analyze consumer voices on the web; and Social Monitor, a risk monitoring tool that constantly checks the consumer voices. The company also offers FollowUP, a tool that analyzes the behavior of the store visitors; and artificial intelligence solutions comprising data crawling, image processing, and social media data analysis. Datasection Inc. was incorporated in 2000 and is based in Tokyo, Japan.

Silicon Studio Corporation develops game engine and middleware products in Japan and internationally. It operates through two segments, development promotion and support business and human resources business. The company offers YEBIS, an optical effects middleware; Enlighten, process global illumination in real time while minimizing the load on GPU; Mizuchi, the real-time rendering engine used in gaming and virtual reality (VR), video and animation, product and architectural visualization, etc.; Motion Portrait, a CG technology to create facial animation from a digital photo; and Enlighten, a lighting technology that delivers real-time global illumination over mobile, desktop, and VR platforms. It offers human resource services comprising development, consulting, outsourcing, and staffing, including temporary, temporary-to-permanent, and full-time placement services. In addition, it offers various solutions comprising training image solutions for machine learning; game engine use in the industrial field; 3D digital twin/industrial metaverse; urban space visualization; design review solution; driving simulator compatible solution; digital twin solutions using point clouds and photogrammetry; online, cloud development solutions; and game development environment construction support. The company was incorporated in 1999 and is headquartered in Tokyo, Japan.

Collabos Corporation develops and provides cloud-based call center systems. It offers nyplace, an IP telephone exchange service; COLLABOS PHONE, an IP-PBX/CTI system developed; GROWCE, a CRM and marketing service; COLLABOS CRM, inbound CRM service; COLLABOS CRM Outbound Edition, an outbound CRM service; Packet Folder, a call recording service; AmiVoice Communication Suite, a voice recognition service; Afullect, an overflow call collection service; GOLDEN LIST, a data analysis service; VLOOM, an IP-PBX/CTI system AI technology; UZ, an AI marketing system, and CollasQ, a FAQ service. Showcase Inc. engages in the SaaS, advertisement and media, cloud integration, investment, and information and communications businesses in Japan. It operates in four segments: DX Cloud Business; Advertising and Media Business; Investment Related Business; and Information and Communications Related Business. The DX Cloud Business segment offers the NaviCast series, a web marketing support service that consists of smartphone converter, site personalizer, form assist, AI-OCR, and form converter services; the ProTech series comprising ID checker, AI-OCR, AI masking, license reader, MFA by SMS, and mail checker; and the Omotenashi Suite, an online procedure platform that connects companies and customers, as well as digital transformation support development services. Its Advertising and Media Business segment provides advertisement-related services; Showcase Plus media; bitWave and Sumaho-no-Susume, which cover smartphone-related information comprising terminals, carriers, and SIM cards; Financial Lab and KIN-YU Lab, an information media that offers finance-related information; cody, a programming school introduction media; ReYuu and Hikari Choice, an information media for fiber optic lines and low-cost SIMs; and Naruto Smartphone, a smartphone information media for beginners. The Investment Related Business segment manages SmartPitch, an online matching platform that connects companies, investors, and startup entrepreneurs. Its Information and Communications Related Business segment is involved in the sale, purchase, and rental of used communication terminals and equipment, such as smartphones, tablets, and personal computers. Showcase Inc. was incorporated in 1996 and is headquartered in Tokyo, Japan.

MKSystem Corporation provides system development and cloud services in Japan. The company offers Shalom, a business support cloud system for labor consultant and social insurance offices; Company Edition, to reduce the workload of the employment insurance and social insurance application procedure in the human resources and general affairs department for general companies; DirectHR, a solution for social insurance, labor consultant offices, and general enterprises; and eNEN for year-end tax adjustment changes. It also provides Cloud Pocket for delivering the documents. MKSystem Corporation was incorporated in 1989 and is headquartered in Osaka, Japan.

Aiming Inc. engages in the planning, production, development, and operation of online games for PCs, smartphones, and home game consoles in Japan and internationally. Aiming Inc. was incorporated in 2011 and is headquartered in Shibuya, Japan.

Mobile Factory, Inc. engages in the development of mobile games in Japan. The company operates in two segments, Mobile Game Business and Content Business. It offers location-based games, including Station Memories!, EKIMEMO! Our Rails, and EKI-DASH series; and distributes ringtones, stamp materials, and other mobile contents through telecommunications carriers. GreenBee, Inc. provides green and digital transformation and technology licensing services in Japan. It provides green transformation products and solutions, including EV and quick chargers, industrial and home energy storage systems, risen hyper-ion solar panels, and smart data logger devices. JIG-SAW INC., a software technology company, provides IoT data control services in Japan. It offers auto sensing and auto control technology platform and services; end-to-end automatic data control services; and big data, cloud, servers, networks, various applications, various platforms, security software, IoT devices, communication modules, various equipment, devices, cells, organisms, etc. The company also provides secure data control and interactive control services on the mobile edge computing (MEC) platform; research and development of autonomous driving software, next-generation real-time OS, next-generation modules, etc.; direct control of cells and organisms using software; and automation, decentralization, and sharing of all industries based on operation technology (OT). TerraSky Co.,Ltd. provides cloud products and solutions in Japan and internationally. Digital Information Technologies Corporation operates as an information services company. iRidge, Inc. engages in the application, business production, and fintech businesses in Japan. It also provides APPBOX, an app business platform that is premised on linking with external systems and various third-party tools; APPBOX partner program; and app planning/RFP support services. PCI Holdings, Inc. engages in the information service business. The company operates through Engineering business, Product/device busines, and ICT Solutions Business segments. Internetworking and Broadband Consulting Co.,Ltd. engages in the development, sale, and support of IT system performance monitoring tools in Japan. NEOJAPAN Inc. engages in the development and sale of packaged software in Japan and internationally. In addition, the company engages in the operation of cloud-based software; sales of software license; provision of system engineering services for enterprises and related services; and development and sales of products.
